course.title: Let's Learn English
course.pitch: A small self-study shell for VOA Learning English. Level 1 is complete (52 lessons). Level 2 has started (5 lessons). Watch the official lesson video, read the English–Chinese dialogue, then check yourself with a short quiz. Your progress stays on this device.
course.disclaimer: This is an unofficial study helper. Lesson videos and scripts come from VOA Learning English and are in the public domain. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Voice of America.

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 1
lessons.subtitle: Welcome!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi! Are you Anna?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！你是安娜吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! Hi there! Are you Pete?
dialogue.zh: 是的！你好！你是皮特吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I am Pete.
dialogue.zh: 我是皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's try that again. I'm Anna. Nice to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 我们再试一次。我是安娜。很高兴认识你。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I'm Pete. "Anna" Is that A-N-A?
dialogue.zh: 我是皮特。“安娜”是拼成 A-N-A 吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. A-N-N-A
dialogue.zh: 不是。是 A-N-N-A。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, Anna with two "n's" ... Welcome to ... 1400 Irving Street!
dialogue.zh: 好的，有两个 n 的安娜……欢迎来到……欧文街 1400 号！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My new apartment! Yes!
dialogue.zh: 我的新公寓！太好了！

quiz.prompt: Who greets Anna first?
How do you spell Anna's name?
Where is Anna's new apartment?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 2
lessons.subtitle: Hello, I'm Anna!

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Hey, Pete! Who’s your friend?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，皮特！你的朋友是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: She is Anna. She is new to D.C.
dialogue.zh: 她是安娜。她刚到华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 你来自哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am from a small town.
dialogue.zh: 我来自一个小镇。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Well, welcome to D.C.
dialogue.zh: 好的，欢迎来到华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I am Jonathan. I am in apartment B4.
dialogue.zh: 我是乔纳森。我住在 B4 公寓。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.
dialogue.zh: 我住在 C2 公寓。玛莎是我的室友。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I know Marsha. She is nice.
dialogue.zh: 我认识玛莎。她人很好。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And I am in Apartment D7. I have to go now.
dialogue.zh: 我住在 D7 公寓。我现在得走了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh!
dialogue.zh: 哦！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you’re here.
dialogue.zh: 记得给上班的玛莎打电话。告诉她你到了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right, thanks, Pete. Nice to meet you!
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢，皮特。很高兴认识你！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: You too, Bye.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，再见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Apartment C2, here I come!
dialogue.zh: C2 公寓，我来了！

quiz.prompt: Where is Anna from?
Who lives in apartment B4?
Who is Marsha?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 3
lessons.subtitle: I'm Here!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am in my new apartment! Great!
dialogue.zh: 我在我的新公寓里了！太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I live with Marsha. We’re roommates.
dialogue.zh: 我和玛莎住在一起。我们是室友。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to cook dinner. Oh! Hmmm. Is there a supermarket near here?
dialogue.zh: 我想做晚饭。哦！嗯……这附近有超市吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha knows. Marsha's work number is 555-8986.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎知道。玛莎上班的电话是 555-8986。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Hello.
dialogue.zh: 喂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello. Is this Marsha? It is Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好。是玛莎吗？我是安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: I am sorry. You have the wrong number.
dialogue.zh: 对不起。你打错电话了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Is this 555-8986?

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: No. This is 555-8689.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Excuse me!
dialogue.zh: 哦。不好意思！

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.en: Okay. 'Bye.
dialogue.zh: 好的。再见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One more time. 555-8986. Please be Marsha.
dialogue.zh: 再打一次。555-8986。希望是玛莎。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hello. This is Marsha.
dialogue.zh: 喂。我是玛莎。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Marsha. I want to cook dinner.
dialogue.zh: 是的，玛莎。我想做晚饭。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Excuse me? Anna? Is that you?
dialogue.zh: 什么？安娜？是你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, yes. I am here!
dialogue.zh: 哦，是的。我到了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Good. You are there.
dialogue.zh: 很好。你在那里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to find a supermarket.
dialogue.zh: 我想找一家超市。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Oh, okay. The supermarket is at 1500 Irving Street. It is near the apartment.
dialogue.zh: 哦，好的。超市在欧文街 1500 号。就在公寓附近。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great! Goodbye!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！再见！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Goodbye, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There is a big supermarket on our street. And Marsha says I am a good cook! Until next time! Bye!
dialogue.zh: 我们这条街上有一家很大的超市。玛莎还说我很会做饭！下次见！再见！

quiz.prompt: What does Anna say about Marsha?
Why does the man say he is sorry?
What does Marsha say about the supermarket?
choices: It is at 1500 Irving Street, near the apartment

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 4
lessons.subtitle: What Is It?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, hi! Hi, we are here!
dialogue.zh: 皮特，嗨！嗨，我们到了！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！嗨，玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: How are you two?
dialogue.zh: 你们俩好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I am great!
dialogue.zh: 我很好！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, Pete, I am new to D.C. The city is big.
dialogue.zh: 你知道的，皮特，我刚到华盛顿特区。这座城市很大。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah. But you learn a little more every day. How's the new apartment?
dialogue.zh: 是啊。不过你每天都会多学一点。新公寓怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The new apartment is great! Let's get coffee!
dialogue.zh: 新公寓很棒！我们去喝咖啡吧！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, do you have a pen?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你有笔吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. I have a pen in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 有。我包里有一支笔。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a …
dialogue.zh: 我有一个……

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It is not a pen. It is a book. It is a big book.
dialogue.zh: 那不是笔。那是一本书。一本很大的书。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes it is, Pete. I know I have a pen, though…
dialogue.zh: 对。是的，皮特。不过我知道我有一支笔……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a ....
dialogue.zh: 我有一个……

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It is not a pen, Anna ... a toy?
dialogue.zh: 那不是笔，安娜……是玩具？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a ....
dialogue.zh: 我有一个……

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And it is a pillow!
dialogue.zh: 那是一个枕头！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, Marsha, I know I have a pen.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，玛莎，我知道我有一支笔。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, it is a map.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，那是一张地图。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Why do you have a map of the world?
dialogue.zh: 你为什么带着一张世界地图？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, Marsha. Now I know I have a pen.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，玛莎。现在我知道我有一支笔了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And now you have a lamp.
dialogue.zh: 现在你又拿出一盏灯。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a pen! Let’s get coffee!
dialogue.zh: 我有笔了！我们去喝咖啡吧！

quiz.prompt: What does Marsha ask Anna for?
What does Pete say about the first thing from Anna's bag?
choices: It is a book. It is a big book

quiz.prompt: What does Anna finally find?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 5
lessons.subtitle: Where Are You?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, everyone! Today my friend Marsha is at her friend's house.
dialogue.zh: 大家好！今天我的朋友玛莎在她朋友家里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She says it is beautiful. I want to see this house! Here we are!
dialogue.zh: 她说那房子很漂亮。我想去看看！我们到了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, I am in the kitchen! It is a beautiful kitchen!
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我在厨房里！这厨房很漂亮！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It is beautiful. We cook in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 是很漂亮。我们在厨房做饭。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I eat in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 我在厨房吃饭。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We relax in the living room.
dialogue.zh: 我们在客厅休息。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I relax in the living room. Marsha, let’s go upstairs!
dialogue.zh: 我在客厅休息。玛莎，我们上楼吧！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna? Where are you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜？你在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, I am in the bathroom! I wash in the bathroom.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我在浴室里！我在浴室洗澡。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I am in the bedroom. We sleep in the bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 我在卧室里。我们在卧室睡觉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I sleep in the bedroom!
dialogue.zh: 我在卧室睡觉！

quiz.prompt: Where is Marsha today?
Where do they cook?
Where is Anna when Marsha asks, "Where are you?"

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 6
lessons.subtitle: Where Is the Gym?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! I’m Anna and I live in Washington, D.C.
dialogue.zh: 大家好！我是安娜，住在华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Every day I learn more about this great city. People in Washington like to work out!
dialogue.zh: 我每天都对这座很棒的城市了解得更多。华盛顿的人喜欢锻炼！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, hi, Pete. How’s it going?
dialogue.zh: 哦，嗨，皮特。最近怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. It’s going great. How’s it going with you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。很好。你怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Things are awesome! Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?
dialogue.zh: 棒极了！皮特，我想去锻炼。健身房在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The gym is across from the lounge. It’s next to the mailroom. Go that way.
dialogue.zh: 健身房在休息厅对面。就在收发室旁边。走那边。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Pete!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，皮特！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, Anna! Not that way! Go that way!
dialogue.zh: 不，安娜！不是那边！走这边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Pete. This is not the gym.
dialogue.zh: 哦，皮特。这不是健身房。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: That’s right, Anna. This is the mailroom.
dialogue.zh: 没错，安娜。这是收发室。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The gym is across from … what?
dialogue.zh: 健身房在……什么对面？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The gym is across from the lounge.
dialogue.zh: 健身房在休息厅对面。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Across from the lounge. Right. Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 在休息厅对面。对。谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete! This is not the gym!
dialogue.zh: 皮特！这不是健身房！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: The gym is across from the lounge. It is behind the lobby.
dialogue.zh: 健身房在休息厅对面。它在大堂后面。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Right. See you.
dialogue.zh: 对。对。再见。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: See you, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is not the gym. This is a parking garage.
dialogue.zh: 这不是健身房。这是停车场。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is not a gym. This is a rooftop.
dialogue.zh: 这不是健身房。这是屋顶。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I want to work out too! Join me!
dialogue.zh: 我也想锻炼！一起来吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m good.
dialogue.zh: 我就算了。

quiz.prompt: What does Anna want to do?
Where is the gym?
choices: Across from the lounge, next to the mailroom

quiz.prompt: What does Pete say when Anna finds the gym?
choices: I want to work out too! Join me!

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 7
lessons.subtitle: What Are You Doing?

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Come in.
dialogue.zh: 进来。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Well, Anna, welcome.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，欢迎。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I am your boss, Caty Weaver. But, please call me Caty.
dialogue.zh: 我是你的老板，凯蒂·韦弗。不过，请叫我凯蒂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢您，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Just Caty.
dialogue.zh: 叫凯蒂就行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 好的，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Okay then. Are you excited?
dialogue.zh: 那好。你兴奋吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I am excited!
dialogue.zh: 是的，我很兴奋！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: So sorry, but I am busy. Please meet your co-workers. But remember, they are busy working.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我很忙。去见见你的同事吧。不过记住，他们正在忙着工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! I’m Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好！我是安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. I’m Anne.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。我是安妮。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你。你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Um, I’m writing.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我在写东西。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You are writing! You are writing a lot!
dialogue.zh: 你在写东西！你写得真多！

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: No! No! That's okay.
dialogue.zh: 不！不！没关系。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am sorry!
dialogue.zh: 对不起！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: and people all around the world are waiting to hear news about the next president…
dialogue.zh: 全世界的人都在等待下一位总统的消息……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Jonathan, hi! Remember me? I live in your building.
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森，嗨！还记得我吗？我住在你那栋楼里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I am doing my show!
dialogue.zh: 我在做我的节目！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, sorry. Are you recording?
dialogue.zh: 哦，抱歉。你在录音吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Yes! And, now I have to record again!
dialogue.zh: 是的！现在我又得重新录一遍！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Have a good show.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。节目顺利。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: The word of the day is social.
dialogue.zh: 今日单词是 social。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you! What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你！你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I’m reading.
dialogue.zh: 我在读稿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you reading the news?
dialogue.zh: 你在读新闻吗？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: No, I’m reading for my show.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我在为我的节目读稿。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna! Hi! What’re you doing?
dialogue.zh: 安娜！嗨！你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am bothering people, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 我在打扰别人，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Let’s go to my office and talk.
dialogue.zh: 我们去我办公室谈谈。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I like to talk with you, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢和您聊天，韦弗女士。

quiz.prompt: Who is Anna's boss?
What is Anne doing?
What does Anna say she is doing at the end?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 8
lessons.subtitle: Are You Busy?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, everyone. Here I am at my new job!
dialogue.zh: 大家好。我现在在新工作的地方！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yesterday at my first day of work … Well, let’s not talk about yesterday. Today is a new day!
dialogue.zh: 昨天是我上班的第一天……算了，我们别提昨天了。今天是新的一天！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today I want to apologize to my co-workers.
dialogue.zh: 今天我想向同事们道歉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Anne. Are you busy?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安妮。你忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. Yes. At 10 a.m. I am writing. Every day I do my morning show. Sorry!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。是的。上午 10 点我在写稿。我每天都做早间节目。抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. See you later, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 好的。也许回头见。

dialogue.speaker: Anne
dialogue.en: Maybe I’ll see you later.
dialogue.zh: 也许回头见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Jonathan. Are you busy?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，乔纳森。你忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Yes, I’m busy. When the studio light is on, I am recording my evening show.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我很忙。演播室的灯亮着的时候，我在录晚间节目。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Sorry about yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 好的。昨天的事抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: No worries.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: May I see the studio?
dialogue.zh: 我可以看看演播室吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Um, maybe another time? Right now I am busy.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，下次吧？我现在很忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Amelia! Are you busy?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿米莉亚！你忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I’m a little busy.
dialogue.zh: 我有一点忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to say I’m sorry for yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我想为昨天的事说对不起。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: It’s okay, Anna. Come by this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 没关系，安娜。今天下午再来。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Are you busy?
dialogue.zh: 你忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, Ms. Weaver. I am busy.
dialogue.zh: 是的，韦弗女士。我很忙。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: My office. 5:00 p.m.
dialogue.zh: 来我办公室。下午 5 点。

dialogue.speaker: Co-Workers
dialogue.en: Surprise!
dialogue.zh: 惊喜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A party! Awesome! And I still have my job! Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 派对！太棒了！而且我还保住了工作！下次见！

quiz.prompt: What does Anna want to do today?
What does Anne do at 10 a.m. every day?
choices: She is writing for her morning show
She is recording her evening show

quiz.prompt: What happens in Caty's office at 5:00 p.m.?
choices: The co-workers have a surprise party

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 9
lessons.subtitle: Is It Cold?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, hi, everyone! Here in Washington, DC, the weather changes often.
dialogue.zh: 哦，大家好！在华盛顿特区，天气常常变化。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One day is cold and windy. But the next day is warm and sunny! So, every day I check the forecast.
dialogue.zh: 有一天又冷又刮风。可第二天又暖和又晴朗！所以我每天都看天气预报。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Phone? What is today’s temperature?
dialogue.zh: 喂，手机？今天气温是多少？

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Today it is 18 degrees ...
dialogue.zh: 今天是 18 度……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Eighteen degrees! That is cold!
dialogue.zh: 18 度！好冷！

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: … eighteen degrees Celsius.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Celsius. That is 65 degrees Fahrenheit. That’s warm.
dialogue.zh: 哦，是摄氏度。那是华氏 65 度。那很暖和。

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Yes, Anna. It is warm.
dialogue.zh: 是的，安娜。天气暖和。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Phone. Is it windy today?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，手机。今天刮风吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: No, it is not windy today.
dialogue.zh: 不，今天不刮风。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Is it sunny today?
dialogue.zh: 今天晴天吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Yes, Anna. It is sunny.
dialogue.zh: 是的，安娜。今天是晴天。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Is it snowy today?
dialogue.zh: 今天下雪吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: No, Anna. It is not snowy.
dialogue.zh: 不，安娜。今天不下雪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today the weather is warm and sunny -- great for seeing Washington, D.C.
dialogue.zh: 今天天气暖和又晴朗——很适合游览华盛顿特区。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Phone! It is not warm and sunny! It is cold and windy and snowy!
dialogue.zh: 手机！今天并不暖和晴朗！又冷，又刮风，还下雪！

dialogue.speaker: Phone
dialogue.en: Anna, it is not cold, windy, or snowy. It is warm and sunny … in Mexico City, Mexico.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，并不冷，也不刮风，更不下雪。暖和又晴朗的是……墨西哥的墨西哥城。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. I see. Mexico.
dialogue.zh: 哦。我明白了。墨西哥。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington weather changes often. Remember to check the forecast -- the right forecast.
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿的天气常常变化。记得看天气预报——要看正确的预报。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

quiz.prompt: What is 18 degrees Celsius in Fahrenheit?
What does the phone first say about the weather?
Where is the warm, sunny weather?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 10
lessons.subtitle: Come Over to My Place

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi! Today, my friend Ashley, is coming over. I am showing her my new apartment!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！今天我的朋友阿什莉要来。我要带她看看我的新公寓！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! That’s Ashley calling.
dialogue.zh: 哦！是阿什莉打来的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hi Anna! I’m coming to your apartment. Where is your apartment?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！我正去你的公寓。你的公寓在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My apartment is near the Columbia Heights Metro.
dialogue.zh: 我的公寓在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: It is near the Columbia Heights Metro?
dialogue.zh: 是在哥伦比亚高地地铁站附近吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Exit the Metro and turn right. Then at the bus station turn left. Then walk straight ahead.
dialogue.zh: 对。出地铁后向右转。然后在公交站向左转。接着一直往前走。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay. Exit Metro, turn right, turn left, then go straight ahead?
dialogue.zh: 好的。出地铁，右转，左转，然后一直往前走？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. My apartment is near a coffee shop.
dialogue.zh: 对。我的公寓在一家咖啡店附近。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay. See you soon!
dialogue.zh: 好的。一会儿见！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, Which coffee shop? There are three coffee shops.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，哪家咖啡店？这里有三家咖啡店。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, my apartment is across from a big department store.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我的公寓在一家大百货商店对面。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: A big department store? Ah, I see it!
dialogue.zh: 一家大百货商店？啊，我看到了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley! Over here! It’s Anna!
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉！这边！是我，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love having my friends over. Come on!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢请朋友来家里。来吧！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Great!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

quiz.prompt: Where is Anna's apartment?
What does Anna tell Ashley to do after she exits the Metro?
choices: Turn right, then at the bus station turn left

quiz.prompt: What is Anna's apartment across from?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 11
lessons.subtitle: This Is My Neighborhood

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! DC is a city for walking. In our neighborhood, I can do all my errands. Marsha, before we get ice cream, I need to return three books to the library. Where is the library?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区很适合走路。在我们这个街区，我能办完所有事。玛莎，吃冰淇淋之前，我要先去图书馆还三本书。图书馆在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It is on this street on the corner.
dialogue.zh: 就在这条街的拐角。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Let's go!
dialogue.zh: 走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, I can return the books here.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我可以在这里还书。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, what are those in the books?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，书里那些是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, these are letters to my family and friends back home … four letters! Is there a post office near here?
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，这些是寄给老家家人和朋友的信……一共四封！这附近有邮局吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um, no. The post office is far from here. But there is a mailbox across from the store.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，没有。邮局离这儿很远。不过商店对面有一个邮筒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome! Let’s go!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, now I need to buy stamps.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，现在我需要买邮票。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you have cash?
dialogue.zh: 你有现金吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Is there a bank near here?
dialogue.zh: 没有。这附近有银行吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: There is a bank behind you.
dialogue.zh: 你身后就有一家银行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Marsha. You know our neighborhood so well.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，玛莎。你对我们这个街区太熟了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now I have cash. I can buy stamps.
dialogue.zh: 现在我有现金了。我可以买邮票了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That store sells stamps.
dialogue.zh: 那家店卖邮票。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait here.
dialogue.zh: 在这儿等我。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have stamps.
dialogue.zh: 我买到邮票了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Wow, you’re fast.
dialogue.zh: 哇，你真快。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you, thank you letters, for sending my words… my love … to my family and friends -
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你们，信啊，把我的话……我的爱……带给我的家人和朋友——

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you have more cash?
dialogue.zh: 你还有现金吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I do!
dialogue.zh: 有！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha and Anna
dialogue.en: Ice cream!!
dialogue.zh: 冰淇淋！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love my new neighborhood! Everything is near our apartment! Even hair salons, and ice cream!
dialogue.zh: 我爱我的新街区！一切都在我们公寓附近！连美发店和冰淇淋都有！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

quiz.prompt: What does Anna need to do before they get ice cream?
choices: Return three books to the library
Mail four letters at the post office

quiz.prompt: Where is the mailbox?
choices: On the corner of the library

quiz.prompt: What do Anna and Marsha want at the end?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 12
lessons.subtitle: Meet My Family

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many beautiful parks. In fact, this park reminds me of my home very far away.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区有很多漂亮的公园。其实，这个公园让我想起很远的家乡。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, here's your coffee.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，这是你的咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Marsha.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，玛莎。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What's wrong?
dialogue.zh: 怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm thinking about my family. I'm feeling homesick.
dialogue.zh: 我在想我的家人。我有点想家。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you want to talk about it?
dialogue.zh: 你想聊聊吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure! I have some photos.
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我有一些照片。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, you do!
dialogue.zh: 是的。你确实有！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Photos really help.
dialogue.zh: 照片真的很有帮助。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is my mother and this is my father. They are rodeo clowns.
dialogue.zh: 这是我妈妈，这是我爸爸。他们是牛仔竞技小丑。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What do rodeo clowns do?
dialogue.zh: 牛仔竞技小丑做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They make jokes at a rodeo. They make people laugh.
dialogue.zh: 他们在牛仔竞技会上讲笑话。他们逗人笑。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That's very different.
dialogue.zh: 那可真特别。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Who is that woman in the picture?
dialogue.zh: 照片里那个女人是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is my Aunt Lavender. She is my mom's sister. She loves gardening and makes spoons.
dialogue.zh: 那是我的姨妈拉文德。她是我妈妈的姐姐。她喜欢园艺，还做勺子。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: She makes spoons?
dialogue.zh: 她做勺子？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course.
dialogue.zh: 当然。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That, too, is very different.
dialogue.zh: 那也很特别。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! This is my Uncle John. He is my father's brother.
dialogue.zh: 哦！这是我的叔叔约翰。他是我爸爸的哥哥。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What does Uncle John do?
dialogue.zh: 约翰叔叔做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: He's a chicken farmer. And makes guitars. He's awesome, and I'm his favorite niece.
dialogue.zh: 他是养鸡的。还做吉他。他很棒，我是他最喜欢的侄女。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Who are they?
dialogue.zh: 他们是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They are my cousins. They are my Uncle John's daughter and son.
dialogue.zh: 他们是我的堂兄弟姐妹。是约翰叔叔的女儿和儿子。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What do they do?
dialogue.zh: 他们做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They raise sheep and make sweaters.
dialogue.zh: 他们养羊，还织毛衣。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Yeah, that's not a surprise.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，这倒不意外。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Thanks for showing me your family photos. Your family is very different.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你给我看家人的照片。你的家人很特别。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I do feel better. Thanks for listening. I have many more photos!
dialogue.zh: 我确实感觉好多了。谢谢你听我说。我还有很多照片！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Yeah. Yeah, you do.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。是的，你确实有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington, DC is my new home. But I like remembering my old home, too.
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区是我的新家。不过我也喜欢想起我的老家。

quiz.prompt: How is Anna feeling?
What do Anna's mother and father do?
Who is Aunt Lavender?

lessons.attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 12: Meet My Family (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 13
lessons.subtitle: Happy Birthday, William Shakespeare!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! In Washington D.C. there are many things to do on a Sunday afternoon. I like to exercise. I like to shop. I like to garden. But today I feel bored. When I feel bored I always look for something unusual to do! I hear music. Let’s go see! What is going on here?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！在华盛顿特区，周日下午有很多事可以做。我喜欢锻炼。我喜欢购物。我喜欢园艺。可今天我觉得无聊。无聊的时候，我总是找点特别的事做！我听到音乐了。我们去看看！这里在干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: It’s a big birthday party for the writer William Shakespeare.
dialogue.zh: 这是作家威廉·莎士比亚的大型生日派对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is a party for William Shakespeare?
dialogue.zh: 这是给威廉·莎士比亚办的派对？

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Yes!
dialogue.zh: 是的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is a drum band. I never listen to a drum band. But today I am listening to a drum band because it’s Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 这是鼓乐队。我从来没听过鼓乐队。可今天我在听鼓乐队，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is a puppet show. I never watch puppet shows. But today I am watching a puppet show because it’s Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 这是木偶戏。我从来不看木偶戏。可今天我在看木偶戏，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My clothes are usual. His clothes are unusual.
dialogue.zh: 我的衣服很平常。他的衣服不平常。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In Washington, D.C. seeing a politician or even the President is usual. Seeing the Queen of England is very unusual! Your majesty!
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区，见到政客甚至总统都很平常。见到英国女王就非常不平常！女王陛下！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is sword fighting. I never sword fight. But today I am sword fighting because it’s Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 这是击剑。我从来不击剑。可今天我在击剑，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are many things to do in Washington, D.C. -- some usual, some unusual.
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区有很多事可以做——有的平常，有的不平常。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, I am not bored because … it is William Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 今天我不无聊了，因为……今天是威廉·莎士比亚的生日！

quiz.prompt: Why is there a big party?
choices: It is a birthday party for William Shakespeare

quiz.prompt: What does Anna say she never watches?
What is very unusual in Washington, D.C.?

lessons.attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 13: Happy Birthday, William Shakespeare! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 14
lessons.subtitle: How About This?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, there! In Washington, D.C. people do many things in the evening. They go listen to music. They eat at a restaurant. They go to the theater.
dialogue.zh: 大家好！在华盛顿特区，人们晚上会做很多事。他们去听音乐。他们去餐馆吃饭。他们去看戏。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Tonight I am going to the theater with my friends. But I don’t know what clothes to wear. Maybe this magazine can help.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要和朋友去剧院。可我不知道穿什么。也许这本杂志能帮上忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Her clothes are beautiful! I really want a friend like her to help me.
dialogue.zh: 她的衣服真漂亮！我真想有个像她这样的朋友来帮我。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Who are you?
dialogue.zh: 你是谁？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: I am Genie! You want help. I am here to help you find the right clothes!
dialogue.zh: 我是精灵！你需要帮助。我来帮你找到合适的衣服！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome! How about jeans and a t-shirt?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！牛仔裤和 T 恤怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: No! Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual. How about something more formal?
dialogue.zh: 不行！牛仔裤和 T 恤太休闲了。穿正式一点的怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 好啊！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! Genie, this dress is beautiful. But it’s not the right size. It’s too small.
dialogue.zh: 哇！精灵，这件裙子很漂亮。可尺码不对。太小了。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Yes, it is too small. But green looks great on you.
dialogue.zh: 是的，太小了。不过绿色很适合你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Take off the green dress. Let’s try a green shirt and a skirt.
dialogue.zh: 把绿裙子脱下来。我们试试绿衬衫和裙子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, Genie! This green shirt is too large and this orange skirt is too orange.
dialogue.zh: 哦，精灵！这件绿衬衫太大了，这条橙色裙子也太橙了。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Yes, the right size for you is medium. Let’s try again.
dialogue.zh: 是的，你的正确尺码是中号。我们再试一次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, I don’t like this outfit.
dialogue.zh: 哦，我不喜欢这套衣服。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: No. That does not match.
dialogue.zh: 不行。那不搭配。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Nothing.
dialogue.zh: 什么都没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: These clothes are formal: a suit jacket, a dress shirt and a tie! They look great!
dialogue.zh: 这些衣服很正式：西装外套、正装衬衫和领带！看起来很棒！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Those clothes look great … for a man! Something is wrong.
dialogue.zh: 那些衣服看起来很棒……对男人来说！有点不对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let me see.
dialogue.zh: 让我看看。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There. Now try.
dialogue.zh: 好了。现在试试。

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Oh. Thanks! Now these clothes look great on you!
dialogue.zh: 哦。谢谢！现在这些衣服穿在你身上很棒！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They do! Um, Genie, can you put on a gold belt?
dialogue.zh: 是的！嗯，精灵，你能加上一条金腰带吗？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 当然！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: That looks great.
dialogue.zh: 看起来很棒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you put on a jacket?
dialogue.zh: 你能加上一件外套吗？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Why not?
dialogue.zh: 为什么不呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love the jacket! How about a hat?
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢这件外套！帽子怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Why not?
dialogue.zh: 为什么不呢？

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Mm, take off the hat. That’s better.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，把帽子摘掉。这样更好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Genie, these clothes look and feel great! Let’s go to the theater!
dialogue.zh: 精灵，这些衣服看起来、穿起来都很棒！我们去剧院吧！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Sorry, Anna. I have to help other friends. Go to the magazine if you want me to help again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，安娜。我还要去帮别的朋友。要是还想让我帮忙，就去找那本杂志。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Genie. Sure thing. Goodbye!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，精灵。没问题。再见！

dialogue.speaker: Genie
dialogue.en: Goodbye!
dialogue.zh: 再见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are many places in DC to go for a great evening out! And it’s nice to have a friend to help me look my best. Until next time! Bye!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有很多地方适合过一个美好的夜晚！有个朋友帮我打扮得漂漂亮亮，真好。下次见！再见！

quiz.prompt: Where is Anna going tonight?
Why does Genie say no to jeans and a t-shirt?
What is the right size for Anna?

lessons.attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 14: How About This? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 15
lessons.subtitle: I Love People-Watching!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! People from all over the world come to Washington, D.C. When I’m at work, I love eating lunch outside. I like to watch people walking by. They all look very different. Today, my friend Ashley is eating lunch with me.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！世界各地的人都会来华盛顿特区。上班的时候，我喜欢在外面吃午饭。我喜欢看路过的人。他们看起来都不一样。今天，我的朋友阿什莉和我一起吃午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, today the weather is beautiful, isn’t it?
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，今天天气真好，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. Ahh. Ooh, we have to return to work!
dialogue.zh: 是的。啊。哦，我们得回去上班了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, we have time! Let’s people-watch a little more.
dialogue.zh: 不，我们还有时间！再看一会儿路人吧。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, I know her. She works in my office! Keyana, hi! Come and join us!
dialogue.zh: 哦，我认识她。她在我办公室工作！基亚娜，嗨！过来一起坐吧！

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: Hi Anna, how are you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜，你好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m doing great! Keyana, this is my friend Ashley.
dialogue.zh: 我很好！基亚娜，这是我的朋友阿什莉。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We need to return to work. But the weather is beautiful and people-watching is fun!
dialogue.zh: 我们得回去上班。可天气真好，看路人也很有趣！

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: I love people-watching too!
dialogue.zh: 我也喜欢看路人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, have a seat! It is fun to see how people are different or the same.
dialogue.zh: 那就坐吧！看看大家哪里不同、哪里相同，很有意思。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: It is. For example, Anna, you are tall. But Ashley and I are short.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。比如说，安娜，你很高。可阿什莉和我都很矮。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And Keyana, you and Ashley have brown eyes; I have blue eyes.
dialogue.zh: 还有，基亚娜，你和阿什莉是棕色眼睛；我是蓝眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: You two have light skin and I have dark skin.
dialogue.zh: 你们俩皮肤较浅，我皮肤较深。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, you have straight hair. Keyana and I have curly hair.
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，你是直发。基亚娜和我是卷发。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: You have very curly hair, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你的头发卷得很厉害。

dialogue.speaker: Keyana
dialogue.en: I need to return to work. See you, Anna! Nice to meet you Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 我得回去上班了。再见，安娜！很高兴认识你，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye, Keyana!
dialogue.zh: 再见，基亚娜！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, I have to go, too. Are you returning to work?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我也得走了。你要回去上班吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I still have time. And this sun feels so good!
dialogue.zh: 我还有时间。这阳光感觉真好！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Um, Anna, what does your boss look like?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，安娜，你的老板长什么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She is short. She has straight, light hair.
dialogue.zh: 她个子矮。她是直的浅色头发。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Does she wear glasses?
dialogue.zh: 她戴眼镜吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, she does.
dialogue.zh: 是的。她戴眼镜。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Is she wearing a blue sweater today?
dialogue.zh: 她今天穿着蓝毛衣吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How do you know that?
dialogue.zh: 你怎么知道的？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: She’s coming this way.
dialogue.zh: 她正朝这边走来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh no! Hide me!
dialogue.zh: 哦不！把我藏起来！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Um, bye, Anna. Call me later.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，再见，安娜。回头给我打电话。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bye, Ashley! Talk to you later!
dialogue.zh: 再见，阿什莉！回头聊！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna? Is that you?
dialogue.zh: 安娜？是你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver! Hi!
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士！嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: What are you doing behind that bench?
dialogue.zh: 你在长椅后面干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am looking for my, my … stick. Here it is.
dialogue.zh: 我在找我的、我的……棍子。在这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am people-watching. Oh! But it’s time to return to work!
dialogue.zh: 我在看路人。哦！可是该回去上班了！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: No need to hurry. I love people-watching too! Let’s sit!
dialogue.zh: 不用着急。我也喜欢看路人！我们坐下吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure! Ahh.
dialogue.zh: 好啊！啊。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: It’s a beautiful day, isn’t it?
dialogue.zh: 今天天气真好，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, it is, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 是的。是的，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: People-watching in D.C. is fun. It makes me forget the time!
dialogue.zh: 在特区看路人很有趣。它让我忘了时间！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time! Ahh.
dialogue.zh: 下次见！啊。

quiz.prompt: What do Anna and her friends like to do at lunch?
Who has blue eyes?
What does Anna say her boss looks like?

lessons.attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 15: I Love People-Watching! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 16
lessons.subtitle: Where Are You From?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Washington, D.C. has many tourists! People from different countries come here. Today, my job is to interview tourists. I have to learn why they come here. This is very exciting! Excuse me. I'm Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time for an interview?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区有很多游客！不同国家的人都会来这里。今天我的工作是采访游客。我要了解他们为什么来。这很令人兴奋！打扰一下。我是《新闻》的安娜·马特奥。你有时间接受采访吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: Sure, I have time.
dialogue.zh: 当然，我有时间。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is your name?
dialogue.zh: 你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: My name is Sabrina.
dialogue.zh: 我叫萨布丽娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What country are you from?
dialogue.zh: 你来自哪个国家？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: I'm from Bangladesh.
dialogue.zh: 我来自孟加拉国。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, you are Bangladeshi.
dialogue.zh: 所以你是孟加拉人。

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: That's right! My nationality is Bangladeshi.
dialogue.zh: 对！我的国籍是孟加拉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Do you like Washington, D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢华盛顿特区吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: Yes! The city is very beautiful!
dialogue.zh: 喜欢！这座城市很美！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you like to do in Washington D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 你在华盛顿特区喜欢做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: I like history. So, I like walking around and looking at all the monuments and memorials. They make history come alive!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢历史。所以我喜欢四处走走，看那些纪念碑和纪念堂。它们让历史活了起来！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington has many monuments and memorials. The Washington Monument is behind us! Which is your favorite?
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿有很多纪念碑和纪念堂。华盛顿纪念碑就在我们身后！你最喜欢哪一个？

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: I really like Lincoln Memorial. It is very beautiful. And it feels like Abraham Lincoln is still alive.
dialogue.zh: 我很喜欢林肯纪念堂。它很漂亮。感觉亚伯拉罕·林肯还活着。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome. Thank you for your time, Sabrina!
dialogue.zh: 太好了。谢谢你抽时间，萨布丽娜！

dialogue.speaker: Sabrina
dialogue.en: You're welcome.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's find another tourist.
dialogue.zh: 我们再找一位游客。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! Excuse me. I am Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time for a couple of questions?
dialogue.zh: 哦！打扰一下。我是《新闻》的安娜·马特奥。你有时间回答几个问题吗？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 当然！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you from Washington, D.C.?
dialogue.zh: 你是华盛顿特区人吗？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: No, I'm not.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is your name and where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 你叫什么名字，来自哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: My name is Louis. And I'm from China.
dialogue.zh: 我叫路易斯。我来自中国。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What languages do you speak?
dialogue.zh: 你说哪些语言？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: I speak Chinese and English.
dialogue.zh: 我说中文和英语。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you like about Washington DC?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢华盛顿特区的什么？

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: I like the museums. I really like the art museums.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢博物馆。我特别喜欢艺术博物馆。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Many of the museums are free.
dialogue.zh: 很多博物馆都是免费的。

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: I like that too!
dialogue.zh: 这个我也喜欢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome! Thanks for your time, Louis.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！谢谢你抽时间，路易斯。

dialogue.speaker: Louis
dialogue.en: You're very welcome. Bye!
dialogue.zh: 不客气。再见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, let's find another tourist!
dialogue.zh: 现在，我们再找一位游客！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! I am Anna Matteo from The News. Do you have time to answer a couple of questions?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我是《新闻》的安娜·马特奥。你有时间回答几个问题吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: Sure!
dialogue.zh: 当然！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is your name and where're you from?
dialogue.zh: 你叫什么名字，来自哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: My name is Mehrnoush. I am from Iran. I'm Iranian.
dialogue.zh: 我叫梅尔努什。我来自伊朗。我是伊朗人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What language do they speak in Iran? Is it Persian?
dialogue.zh: 伊朗人说什么语言？是波斯语吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: They speak Farsi.
dialogue.zh: 他们说波斯语（Farsi）。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you like to do in Washington DC?
dialogue.zh: 你在华盛顿特区喜欢做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: Well, I like learning about government and politics.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我喜欢了解政府和政治。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington has many politicians!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿有很多政客！

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: It does! I want to see the U.S. Capitol.
dialogue.zh: 是的！我想去看美国国会大厦。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look, you are very near.
dialogue.zh: 看，你离那儿很近。

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: I am!
dialogue.zh: 是啊！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Have fun!
dialogue.zh: 玩得开心！

dialogue.speaker: Mehrnoush
dialogue.en: Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There you have it. Tourists from all over the world come to Washington, D.C. They all like doing and seeing different things in the city. This is Anna Matteo reporting for The News. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 就是这样。世界各地的游客都会来华盛顿特区。他们喜欢在城里做的、看的都不一样。我是安娜·马特奥，为《新闻》报道。下次见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Is that okay? Awesome! Now, I want to do my favorite thing in the city … ride the carousel!
dialogue.zh: 这样可以吗？太好了！现在我想做城里我最喜欢的事……坐旋转木马！

What languages does Louis speak?
What does Mehrnoush want to see?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 17
lessons.subtitle: Are You Free on Friday?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This city is very interesting, I really like my job, and I have some good friends! Speaking of friends … I see one now! Marsha! Hi!
dialogue.zh: 这座城市很有意思，我很喜欢我的工作，也有一些好朋友！说到朋友……我现在就看到一个！玛莎！嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna. What's going on?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。最近怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Not much. How about you?
dialogue.zh: 没什么。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Busy as usual. Hey, do you wanna see a movie with me?
dialogue.zh: 还是一样忙。嘿，你想和我去看电影吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure! I never have time to see a movie. When?
dialogue.zh: 当然！我从来没时间看电影。什么时候？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Are you busy this Thursday at 6pm?
dialogue.zh: 这个星期四下午 6 点你忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's see …. I'm busy. I am going to tap dance with my friends Thursday night.
dialogue.zh: 我看看……我有事。星期四晚上我要和朋友去跳踢踏舞。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Tap dancing? That sounds fun!
dialogue.zh: 踢踏舞？听起来很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm still learning. But it is fun!
dialogue.zh: 我还在学。不过很有趣！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you busy on Friday night?
dialogue.zh: 星期五晚上你忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Yes. Friday nights are when I visit my parents.
dialogue.zh: 忙。星期五晚上我去看我的父母。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What do you and your family do together?
dialogue.zh: 你和家人一起做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We always eat dinner together and sometimes we play board games.
dialogue.zh: 我们总是一起吃晚饭，有时还会玩棋盘游戏。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Playing board games is fun, too! The word game Scrabble is my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 玩棋盘游戏也很有趣！单词游戏拼字游戏是我的最爱。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I like Connect Four!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢四子棋！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm not busy Monday night. Are you?
dialogue.zh: 星期一晚上我不忙。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I am busy on Monday night. I'm going to jog in the park with my friend. Do you jog?
dialogue.zh: 星期一晚上我忙。我要和朋友去公园慢跑。你慢跑吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! I always jog. Well, sometimes I jog. Okay, I never jog. But I will try because it is good for you.
dialogue.zh: 哦！我总是慢跑。嗯，我有时慢跑。好吧，我从来不慢跑。不过我会试试，因为这对身体好。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I always feel great after I jog.
dialogue.zh: 我慢跑之后总是感觉很好。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: How about on Wednesday night?
dialogue.zh: 星期三晚上怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wednesday night I am not busy. Oh, no, wait. This Wednesday night I will be busy.
dialogue.zh: 星期三晚上我不忙。哦，不对，等一下。这个星期三晚上我会有事。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 你要做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm going to teach children how to play the ukulele.
dialogue.zh: 我要教孩子们弹尤克里里。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, children, play "C." Good. I like your "C."
dialogue.zh: 好了，孩子们，弹 C。很好。我喜欢你们的 C。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: The world does need more ukulele players.
dialogue.zh: 这世界确实需要更多尤克里里演奏者。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, it looks like we'll never have time to see a movie.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，看来我们永远没时间看电影了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait a minute. Are you busy now?
dialogue.zh: 等一下。你现在忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It's Saturday afternoon. This is always when I do my errands.
dialogue.zh: 现在是星期六下午。我总是这个时候办事情。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, but the new Star Wars movie is gonna start in 30 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，不过新的《星球大战》电影 30 分钟后就要开始了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'll do my errands on Sunday. Let's go!
dialogue.zh: 我星期天再办事。走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Most days of the week, people are really busy. But it's important to find time to be with your friends!
dialogue.zh: 一周里大多数日子，人们都很忙。但抽出时间和朋友在一起很重要！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

When does Marsha visit her parents?
What do Anna and Marsha decide to do now?
choices: See the new Star Wars movie

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 18
lessons.subtitle: She Always Does That

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, from Washington, D.C.! Today at work I am reading the news for the first time. I am really nervous. But my boss, Ms. Weaver, is here to help me.
dialogue.zh: 你好，这里是华盛顿特区！今天上班我第一次读新闻。我很紧张。不过我的老板韦弗女士在这儿帮我。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Now, Anna, remember. When we read the news we are always reading facts. We never show our feelings.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，记住。我们读新闻的时候，读的永远是事实。我们从不表现自己的感情。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure thing, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 没问题，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Great. Are you ready?
dialogue.zh: 很好。准备好了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 好了。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Okay, let's try the first story!
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试第一条新闻！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, and welcome to The News.
dialogue.zh: 你好，欢迎收看《新闻》。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A new book is very popular with children and families. This is it.
dialogue.zh: 一本新书在孩子和家庭中很受欢迎。就是这一本。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is about a lost duckling. The duck's mother cannot find him.
dialogue.zh: 讲的是一只迷路的小鸭子。鸭妈妈找不到它。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Stop! Anna, when you say the words "duck" and "duckling" you look really sad.
dialogue.zh: 停！安娜，你说“鸭子”和“小鸭子”的时候，看起来很难过。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I do?
dialogue.zh: 有吗？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Yes. Sad is a feeling.
dialogue.zh: 有。难过是一种感情。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sad is not a fact. Sorry. Let me try again.
dialogue.zh: 难过不是事实。抱歉。让我再试一次。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Okay, she's trying again! And go.
dialogue.zh: 好，她再试一次！开始。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, and welcome to The News. A new book is very popular with children and families. This is it.
dialogue.zh: 你好，欢迎收看《新闻》。一本新书在孩子和家庭中很受欢迎。就是这一本。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is about a lost duckling. The duck's mother can not find 'im. But a family gives him a home.
dialogue.zh: 讲的是一只迷路的小鸭子。鸭妈妈找不到它。不过有一家人给了它一个家。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Stop! Anna, you are doing it again.
dialogue.zh: 停！安娜，你又来了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This story is very sad.
dialogue.zh: 这个故事很让人难过。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I have an idea. Let's read the second story. She's reading the second story. And … go!
dialogue.zh: 我有个主意。我们读第二条新闻。她在读第二条新闻。开始！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, and welcome to The News. In Indiana, a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win The Race Car 500.
dialogue.zh: 你好，欢迎收看《新闻》。在印第安纳州，一位祖母成为第一位赢得赛车 500 的 80 岁女性。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Stop! Stop! Anna, please -- no feelings.
dialogue.zh: 停！停！安娜，拜托——不要感情。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. But it is awesome that an 80-year-old grandmother wins a car race.
dialogue.zh: 好的。可是一位 80 岁的祖母赢了赛车，这确实很棒。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Just the facts, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 只要事实，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, and welcome to The News. In Indiana, a grandmother is the first 80-year-old woman to win The Race Car 500.
dialogue.zh: 你好，欢迎收看《新闻》。在印第安纳州，一位祖母成为第一位赢得赛车 500 的 80 岁女性。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She rarely talks to reporters. But when she does, she often says, "Nothing can stop me now!"
dialogue.zh: 她很少和记者说话。可一旦说了，她常常会说：“现在什么也挡不住我了！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am very happy for her!
dialogue.zh: 我为她感到非常高兴！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Stop, stop, stop!! Anna, you cannot say you are happy.
dialogue.zh: 停，停，停！！安娜，你不能说你高兴。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: But I am happy.
dialogue.zh: 可我就是高兴。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: But you can't say it.
dialogue.zh: 可你不能说出来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: This is the News. Happy and sad are feelings. You can't have them in The News.
dialogue.zh: 这是《新闻》。高兴和难过都是感情。新闻里不能有这些。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. I got it.
dialogue.zh: 好。我明白了。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Okay. Let's try the third story. She's reading the third story!
dialogue.zh: 好。我们试试第三条新闻。她在读第三条新闻！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello and welcome to The News. City politicians in Big Town are using city money to have a big party on a cruise ship. They are taking the money for the party from the children's library.
dialogue.zh: 你好，欢迎收看《新闻》。大城的市政官员正用城市的钱在游轮上办大型派对。他们把派对的钱从儿童图书馆里拿来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What?! That makes me very angry.
dialogue.zh: 什么？！这让我很生气。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: No, no, no! Anna, you cannot say you are angry! This is The News!!!
dialogue.zh: 不，不，不！安娜，你不能说你生气！这是《新闻》！！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What can I do, Ms. Weaver? Take out my feelings and put them here … on the news desk?
dialogue.zh: 那我能怎么办，韦弗女士？把我的感情拿出来，放在这儿……新闻桌上？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes. That's right! Now you've got it!
dialogue.zh: 对。对。就是这样！你终于明白了！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Let's repeat the first story.
dialogue.zh: 我们再把第一条新闻读一遍。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is going to be a very long day.
dialogue.zh: 今天会很长。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

quiz.prompt: What does Ms. Weaver say they never show when they read the news?
What is the first news story about?
choices: A party on a cruise ship

quiz.prompt: Where does Caty tell Anna to put her feelings?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 19
lessons.subtitle: When Do I Start?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! Summer in Washington, D.C. is hot and sunny. I always ride the Metro to work. Riding the Metro is cool and fast. But today it's closed. So, I am walking to work.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区的夏天又热又晴。我总是坐地铁上班。坐地铁又凉快又快。可今天地铁停运了。所以我走路去上班。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver, I am late this morning. The Metro is closed. So, I am walking to work.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士，我今天早上要迟到了。地铁停运了。所以我走路去上班。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: That's too bad. It's really hot today.
dialogue.zh: 真不巧。今天真的很热。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes it is.
dialogue.zh: 是的。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: When you arrive, please come to my office. I have important news to tell you.
dialogue.zh: 你到了以后，请来我办公室。我有重要的消息要告诉你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course. Good-bye. My boss has news for me. The question is: Is it good news or bad news?
dialogue.zh: 当然。再见。老板有消息要告诉我。问题是：是好消息还是坏消息？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 你好，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna, I have good news and I have bad news. Which do you want to hear first?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我有好消息，也有坏消息。你想先听哪个？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The good news. No … okay, the bad news.
dialogue.zh: 好消息。不……好吧，坏消息。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: The bad news is you are not good at reading the news.
dialogue.zh: 坏消息是，你不擅长读新闻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. I am very sorry to hear that.
dialogue.zh: 哦。听到这个我很难过。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: So, starting next month you will not read the news.
dialogue.zh: 所以从下个月开始，你不再读新闻了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Next month is July. You are firing me in July.
dialogue.zh: 下个月是七月。你要在七月开除我。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: No. I am not firing you in July … or in August or in September. That is the good news.
dialogue.zh: 不。我不会在七月开除你……八月、九月也不会。这就是好消息。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. You are not firing me. I am not reading the news. What will I be doing?
dialogue.zh: 好。你不开除我。我不读新闻了。那我要做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Well, you are good at asking questions. You are good at talking to people. You are good at showing your feelings. And you are great at being silly.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你擅长提问。你擅长和人聊天。你擅长表达感情。而且你特别会搞笑。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you, Ms. Weaver. But what does all that mean?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你，韦弗女士。可这些是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I have a new assignment for you! Your skills are perfect for a new show … a children's show.
dialogue.zh: 我给你一个新任务！你的本事很适合一个新节目……儿童节目。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A children's show ... That is awesome! When do I start?
dialogue.zh: 儿童节目……太棒了！我什么时候开始？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: You start next month. Start thinking of ideas for the show.
dialogue.zh: 你下个月开始。先想想节目的点子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have tons of ideas! I can show children what it's like in outer space ...
dialogue.zh: 我有好多点子！我可以给孩子们看外太空是什么样……

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Great …
dialogue.zh: 很好……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … or in the deep, dark ocean …
dialogue.zh: ……或者深深的黑暗海洋……

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Those are great ideas, Anna. Please go think of more … at your desk.
dialogue.zh: 这些点子都很好，安娜。请再多想一些……在你的办公桌那儿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. What other things can I show them? Mt. Everest! Everyone has different skills. You have skills. I have skills. The important thing is to know what you are good at. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 好。我还能给他们看什么？珠穆朗玛峰！每个人都有不同的本事。你有你的本事。我有我的本事。重要的是知道自己擅长什么。下次见！

quiz.prompt: Why is Anna walking to work?
What is the bad news?
choices: The Metro is closed all summer
Anna is not good at reading the news

quiz.prompt: What is Anna's new assignment?
choices: A show about outer space only

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 20
lessons.subtitle: What Can You Do?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, there! Washington, D.C. is a great place to work. Many people here work in government and politics. But there are many other jobs. You can work at a hospital; a university. You can work in a coffee shop. Wait a minute, I think I see a friend of mine. Pete? Is that you?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区是个很好的工作地方。这里很多人在政府和政治领域工作。不过还有很多别的工作。你可以在医院工作；也可以在大学。你还可以在咖啡店工作。等一下，我好像看到一个朋友。皮特？是你吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You look different. Your beard … is really big.
dialogue.zh: 你看起来不一样了。你的胡子……真的很大。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You don't like it, do you?
dialogue.zh: 你不喜欢，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, no. You just look … different.
dialogue.zh: 不，不。你只是看起来……不一样。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you. So, what's wrong? You look sad.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。所以，怎么了？你看起来很难过。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't have a job.
dialogue.zh: 我没有工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry, I can't hear you.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我听不清。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I do not have a job!
dialogue.zh: 我没有工作！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. I'm sorry to hear that, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 哦。听到这个我很难过，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't have a skill.
dialogue.zh: 我没有本事。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Everyone has a skill. You need to find yours.
dialogue.zh: 每个人都有本事。你需要找到你的。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't know, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, I am good at asking questions. Let me ask you some.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，我擅长提问。让我问你几个。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Really, Anna? Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 真的吗，安娜？你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I can. Let me help.
dialogue.zh: 能。让我来帮你。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure, Anna. Maybe you can help.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，安娜。也许你能帮上忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you write code?
dialogue.zh: 你会写代码吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure, c-o-l-d. How is this going to help?
dialogue.zh: 当然，c-o-l-d。这怎么能帮上忙？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, not "cold." Code; you know, for making phone apps, or websites. You can make tons of money writing code.
dialogue.zh: 不是“cold”。是代码；就是做手机应用，或者网站。写代码可以赚很多钱。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Tons of money? But I can't code.
dialogue.zh: 很多钱？可是我不会写代码。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Next question. Can you drive?
dialogue.zh: 下一个问题。你会开车吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Do you mean drive a race car? It's really hard to be a race car driver. First, you need a race car ...
dialogue.zh: 你是说开赛车？当赛车手很难。首先，你得有一辆赛车……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I mean drive a taxi or drive a bus.
dialogue.zh: 不，我是说开出租车或者开公交车。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, I always fall asleep when I drive.
dialogue.zh: 不行，我开车总是睡着。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, that's not good. Next question. Can you teach? You can be a teacher in a school.
dialogue.zh: 哦，那可不好。下一个问题。你会教书吗？你可以在学校当老师。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, I cannot teach.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不会教书。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can you cook? You can be a chef in a restaurant.
dialogue.zh: 你会做饭吗？你可以在餐馆当厨师。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, I can't code! I can't teach! I can't cook! Anna, I can't do anything. This is sad. I'm gonna write about my feelings in my blog.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不会写代码！不会教书！不会做饭！安娜，我什么都不会。这太难过了。我要在博客里写写我的感受。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You write a blog?
dialogue.zh: 你写博客？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, I write a blog.
dialogue.zh: 对，我写博客。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How many followers do you have?
dialogue.zh: 你有多少粉丝？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don't know … 59,538.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, that's a lot of followers! You can make money writing!
dialogue.zh: 皮特，那可是很多粉丝！你可以靠写作赚钱！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Writing is easy. Everyone can write.
dialogue.zh: 写作很容易。每个人都会写。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Not everyone can write well. You can be a writer!
dialogue.zh: 不是每个人都能写得好。你可以当作家！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I can be a writer. I can be a writer! I can be a writer! Thanks, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我可以当作家。我可以当作家！我可以当作家！谢谢，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Pete. Hi, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，皮特。嗨，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hi, Marsha. Excuse me, I have to go.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，玛莎。不好意思，我得走了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Where are you going?
dialogue.zh: 你要去哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I'm going to be a writer!
dialogue.zh: 我要去当作家！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Good luck, Pete!
dialogue.zh: 祝你好运，皮特！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: He does know that it's not easy to be a writer, doesn't he?
dialogue.zh: 他知道当作家并不容易，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are many different jobs you can have in Washington, D.C. Pete wants to be a writer. I wish him luck. Lots of luck. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区，你可以做很多不同的工作。皮特想当作家。我祝他好运。很多好运。下次见！

quiz.prompt: Why is Pete sad?
choices: He does not have a job

He does not have a race car

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 21
lessons.subtitle: Can You Come to the Party?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! Washington, D.C. has some great coffee shops. My favorite is this one -- Busboys & Poets.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区有一些很棒的咖啡店。我最喜欢的就是这一家——Busboys & Poets。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Actually it's more than a coffee shop. It's also a bookstore, a restaurant and a theater!
dialogue.zh: 其实它不只是咖啡店。它还是书店、餐厅，还有剧院！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha and I love coming here.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎和我都喜欢来这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna, my friend is having a party on Saturday. Can you come with me?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜，我朋友星期六要办派对。你能和我一起去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry, I can't come with you. I have to get my driver's license.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我不能和你去。我得去考驾照。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Will you be busy all day?
dialogue.zh: 你会忙一整天吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. First, I have to take a test on the computer. Then I have to take a test in the car.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。先要考电脑上的笔试。然后还要考路上的路考。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: But you have to take the test during the day, don't you?
dialogue.zh: 可你得在白天考试，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 对。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: The party is at night.
dialogue.zh: 派对是在晚上。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Then I can come with you to the party on Saturday night.
dialogue.zh: 哦。那我星期六晚上可以和你去派对。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Great! I have to help my friend with the party. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我得帮朋友筹备派对。你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure. That sounds like fun.
dialogue.zh: 当然。听起来很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Everyone has to bring something or do something. You can bring food, or you can perform.
dialogue.zh: 每个人都得带点东西或者做点什么。你可以带食物，也可以表演。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really, I can perform?
dialogue.zh: 真的吗，我可以表演？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: You can! Can you?
dialogue.zh: 可以！你行吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I can recite poetry.
dialogue.zh: 可以！我会朗诵诗。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: In this country, nobody recites poetry at parties. Um … can you do anything else?
dialogue.zh: 在这个国家，没人在派对上朗诵诗。嗯……你还会别的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hmm, yes. I can do a card trick.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，会。我会纸牌魔术。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, maybe you can just bring food.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，也许你还是带食物吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I can't cook. And I really want to perform. You know, there is one thing I can do.
dialogue.zh: 不行，我不会做饭。而且我真的想表演。你知道，有一件事我会。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Trouble in mind. I'm blue...
dialogue.zh: 心里有烦恼。我很忧郁……

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That's it! You can sing at the party. Now, I have to go shopping for food.
dialogue.zh: 就是这个！你可以在派对上唱歌。现在我得去买食物了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can I help? I'm not busy right now.
dialogue.zh: 我能帮忙吗？我现在不忙。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Sure, let's go!
dialogue.zh: 当然，走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We have to go. I have to help Marsha shop. And I have to practice my song!
dialogue.zh: 我们得走了。我要帮玛莎买东西。我还得练习我的歌！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

quiz.prompt: Why can't Anna go to the party at first?
choices: She has to get her driver's license
She has to work all day

quiz.prompt: When is the party?
What does Marsha say Anna can do at the party?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 22
lessons.subtitle: Next Summer...

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington, D.C. has four seasons: winter, spring, summer and autumn or fall. My favorite season is summer because of summer vacation!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有四个季节：冬、春、夏，还有秋。我最喜欢夏天，因为有暑假！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey, that will be a great subject for my new work assignment -- the children's show. I can teach what families in the U.S. do during summer vacation.
dialogue.zh: 嘿，这会是我新工作任务——儿童节目——的好主题。我可以讲美国的家庭暑假都做什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, I'm planning the show with Amelia. This is the first time we are working together. I hope we can work well together. Hi, Amelia!
dialogue.zh: 今天我和阿梅莉亚一起策划节目。这是我们第一次一起工作。希望我们能合作愉快。嗨，阿梅莉亚！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! So, what are we going to talk about on the first show?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！那第一期节目我们要讲什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want to talk about summer vacation.
dialogue.zh: 我想讲暑假。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: That will be fun! Are you going on vacation this summer?
dialogue.zh: 那会很好玩！你今年夏天去度假吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. This summer I am too busy.
dialogue.zh: 不去。今年夏天我太忙了。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: That's too bad.
dialogue.zh: 真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's okay. I can go on vacation next summer. This show will be a lot of fun too!
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我可以明年夏天再去度假。这个节目也会很好玩！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: So, Anna, what's the plan for the show?
dialogue.zh: 所以，安娜，节目计划是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First, we're going to introduce the subject. Then we can show pictures and video.
dialogue.zh: 首先，我们介绍主题。然后我们可以放图片和视频。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: We can show tons of video!
dialogue.zh: 我们可以放好多视频！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right! We can interview children and have guests, too.
dialogue.zh: 对！我们还可以采访孩子，请嘉宾。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Kids can ask us questions.
dialogue.zh: 孩子们可以问我们问题。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great idea! Finally, we can read the questions and tell them where to learn more.
dialogue.zh: 好主意！最后，我们可以读这些问题，并告诉他们去哪里了解更多。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Okay, let's try it!
dialogue.zh: 好，我们试试！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's do it!
dialogue.zh: 开始吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! And welcome to … Amelia, we don't have a name for the show.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！欢迎收看……阿梅莉亚，我们还没有节目名字。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: We'll think of a name later. For now, we'll call it "The Show."
dialogue.zh: 名字以后再想。现在就叫它“节目”吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. Hi there! And welcome to "The Show."
dialogue.zh: 好。嗨！欢迎收看“节目”。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today we are going to take you on a summer vacation! You will see popular things to do on vacation!
dialogue.zh: 今天我们要带你去过一个暑假！你会看到度假时流行的活动！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One is camping. When you go camping, you cook, sleep and play outdoors!
dialogue.zh: 一个是露营。去露营的时候，你在户外做饭、睡觉和玩耍！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: When I go camping, Anna, I like to go hiking and fishing.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我去露营的时候，喜欢徒步和钓鱼。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me, too. Those are fun things to do when you go camping!
dialogue.zh: 我也是。这些都是露营时很好玩的事！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: These people are hiking.
dialogue.zh: 这些人在徒步。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Okay, let's talk about the next vacation.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们谈谈下一种度假。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Another popular summer vacation is going to an amusement park. At an amusement park, you go on rides and eat lots of fun food!
dialogue.zh: 另一种很受欢迎的暑假是去游乐园。在游乐园，你可以坐游乐设施，吃很多好玩的食物！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I love cotton candy … !
dialogue.zh: 我爱棉花糖……！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Amelia
dialogue.en: and rollercoasters!
dialogue.zh: 还有过山车！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: This show is going to be a lot of fun.
dialogue.zh: 这个节目会很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know!
dialogue.zh: 我知道！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is riding a rollercoaster!
dialogue.zh: 这就是坐过山车！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Whoooo! What is the last vacation?
dialogue.zh: 呜！最后一种度假是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: One of the most popular vacations is … going to the beach!
dialogue.zh: 最受欢迎的度假之一是……去海边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Amelia
dialogue.en: I love the beach!
dialogue.zh: 我爱海边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When I see that blue ocean, I want to leave Washington, D.C. immediately and go to the beach!
dialogue.zh: 我一看到那片蓝色的海，就想马上离开华盛顿特区去海边！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Maybe next summer.
dialogue.zh: 也许明年夏天。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: But right now, it's time to work!
dialogue.zh: 可现在，该工作了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 对。下次见……

quiz.prompt: Why is summer Anna's favorite season?
choices: Because she is going on vacation this summer

quiz.prompt: What do they call the children's show for now?
What is one of the most popular vacations they talk about last?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 23
lessons.subtitle: What Do You Want?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Washington, D.C. has great food from all over the world.
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有来自世界各地的美食。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today I'm having lunch with my boss. Ms. Weaver says we're going on a trip around the world. But she knows I only have an hour for lunch! Silly woman.
dialogue.zh: 今天我和老板一起吃午饭。韦弗女士说我们要去环游世界。可她知道我午饭只有一小时！傻女人。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi Jonathan! Hey, we are meeting Ms. Weaver for lunch at noon, aren't we?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，乔纳森！嘿，我们中午要和韦弗女士见面吃午饭，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What time is it now?
dialogue.zh: 现在几点了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 11:50! We have to go!
dialogue.zh: 11:50！我们得走了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, where is this world food restaurant?
dialogue.zh: 所以，这家世界美食餐厅在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: We're not eating at a restaurant.
dialogue.zh: 我们不是在餐厅吃。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where are we eating?
dialogue.zh: 那我们在哪里吃？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: We are eating at ... food trucks!
dialogue.zh: 我们在……餐车吃！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Food trucks … awesome! What's a food truck?
dialogue.zh: 餐车……太棒了！餐车是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: These are food trucks!
dialogue.zh: 这些就是餐车！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow!
dialogue.zh: 哇！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Whoa!
dialogue.zh: 哇！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Okay, Jonathan, you will buy the first dish. Here is $10. Surprise us!
dialogue.zh: 好，乔纳森，你去买第一道菜。这儿是 10 美元。给我们一个惊喜！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll be back in 15 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好，我 15 分钟后回来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What country do I want to visit?
dialogue.zh: 我想去哪个国家？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Anna, you pick the second country. Here is $10.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你选第二个国家。这儿是 10 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I want chicken.
dialogue.zh: 我想吃鸡肉。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: The food truck, over there, has great chicken.
dialogue.zh: 那边那辆餐车的鸡肉很棒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: After you buy your food, meet me here.
dialogue.zh: 买完食物后，在这儿和我会合。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Excuse me, I'll have the shrimp.
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，我要虾。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Oh, you're out of shrimp. Okay, I'll have the beef then.
dialogue.zh: 哦，虾卖完了。那我要牛肉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello. I want the chicken dish.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我要鸡肉这道菜。

dialogue.speaker: Truck worker
dialogue.en: We're out of chicken.
dialogue.zh: 鸡肉卖完了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You're out of chicken.
dialogue.zh: 鸡肉卖完了。

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.en: Yep.
dialogue.zh: 对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'll try another food truck. Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 我去另一辆餐车看看。谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.en: You're welcome.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Okay, here is your change. The dish is $7. So, here is 1, 2, 3 dollars back from your 10.
dialogue.zh: 好，这是找你的钱。这道菜 7 美元。所以从你的 10 美元里找回 1、2、3 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Great.
dialogue.zh: 很好。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Where's Anna? Is she dancing by that food truck?
dialogue.zh: 安娜呢？她是在那辆餐车旁边跳舞吗？

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, she is.
dialogue.zh: 是的。她是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver, here is your change. The dish costs $5. So - $5 back.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士，这是找你的钱。这道菜 5 美元。所以——找回 5 美元。

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna. But where is the food?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜。可食物呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm eating it. The Peruvian chicken is delicious! Try some!
dialogue.zh: 我在吃。这秘鲁鸡肉很好吃！尝尝！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: Well, we still have $8! What do you want now?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我们还剩 8 美元！现在你想要什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can buy dessert!
dialogue.zh: 我们可以买甜点！

dialogue.speaker: Caty
dialogue.en: I'll buy dessert.
dialogue.zh: 我去买甜点。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In Washington, D.C., you can travel around the world … with food trucks! And it does not cost a lot.
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区，你可以环游世界……靠餐车！而且花不了多少钱。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

quiz.prompt: Where do they eat lunch?
How much does Anna's dish cost?
What does Anna want to buy with the leftover money?
