lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 42
lessons.subtitle: I Was Minding My Own Business

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Hello. I'm Guy Newsman with News Channel XYZ. I'm here in Washington, D.C. at the scene of a crime.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我是 XYZ 新闻频道的盖伊·纽斯曼。我在华盛顿特区的犯罪现场。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: We are talking with this woman. She saw the crime during her lunch break. It looks like she hurt herself while she was trying to stop the crime.
dialogue.zh: 我们正在和这位女士交谈。她午休时看到了这起犯罪。看起来她在试图阻止犯罪时伤到了自己。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Tell us your name.
dialogue.zh: 告诉我们你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Guy. I'm Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，盖伊。我是安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Anna, what did you see and what happened to your arm?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你看到了什么？你的胳膊怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Guy, I was minding my own business. See, I work over there.
dialogue.zh: 盖伊，我当时在管自己的事。看，我在那边上班。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Um-hum
dialogue.zh: 嗯嗯。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I left work to get some lunch. Then suddenly, I heard a woman yelling. She was yelling like this ... "Help! Help!"
dialogue.zh: 我离开公司去吃午饭。然后突然，我听到一个女人在喊。她是这样喊的……“救命！救命！”

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Two robbers were grabbing her bag like this. She was hitting them with her umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 两个劫匪在这样抢她的包。她用雨伞打他们。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Is that when you hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 你就是那时伤到胳膊的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. At that time, I was not fighting the robbers.
dialogue.zh: 不是。那时我并没有和劫匪打。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: See. I was too far away and I didn't have my own umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 看。我离得太远，也没有自己的雨伞。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: So, what happened next?
dialogue.zh: 那么，接下来发生了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They grabbed her bag and ran away! So, I grabbed her umbrella and ran after the robbers.
dialogue.zh: 他们抢走她的包就跑了！所以，我抓起她的雨伞去追劫匪。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Then that is the time that you hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 那就是你伤到胳膊的时候？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. I was yelling, "Stop, robbers! Stop!" She was yelling, "Hey, come back with my umbrella!"
dialogue.zh: 不是。我在喊：“站住，劫匪！站住！”她在喊：“嘿，把我的雨伞还回来！”

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Were you afraid?
dialogue.zh: 你害怕吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I had no time to be afraid, Guy. Well, I had time while I was resting on a bench. I had a lot of time.
dialogue.zh: 我没时间害怕，盖伊。嗯，我在长椅上休息时有时间。我有很多时间。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Then what happened?
dialogue.zh: 然后呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The robbers got on a bus. So, I ran after the bus.
dialogue.zh: 劫匪上了一辆公交车。所以我去追那辆车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: While I was running, I tripped and fell.
dialogue.zh: 我跑的时候绊倒了。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: And that is the time that you hurt your arm?
dialogue.zh: 那就是你伤到胳膊的时候？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. While I was lying on the ground, someone stepped on my arm!
dialogue.zh: 不是。我躺在地上时，有人踩到了我的胳膊！

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Ouch. That's too bad.
dialogue.zh: 哎哟。那太糟了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah. And they didn't apologize. Well, then the robbers got themselves kicked off the bus.
dialogue.zh: 是啊。他们还没道歉。后来，劫匪把自己搞得被赶下了车。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They didn't pay. You've got to pay when you get on a bus. The police came and took them away.
dialogue.zh: 他们没付钱。上车就得付钱。警察来了，把他们带走了。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: And that's when you hurt your arm!
dialogue.zh: 那就是你伤到胳膊的时候！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Then, when did you hurt yourself?
dialogue.zh: 那你是什么时候伤到自己的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, Guy, by this time, I was feeling very hungry. So, I went to my office to get a snack.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，盖伊，这时我已经很饿了。所以我回办公室去拿点心。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.en: Anna, I'm calling for help right now. Hello? Yes, please come right away. My co-worker is stuck in a vending machine.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我现在就打电话求助。喂？是的，请马上过来。我的同事卡在自动售货机里了。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: You hurt your arm in a vending machine buying a bag of chips?
dialogue.zh: 你是在自动售货机里买一袋薯片时伤到胳膊的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I was really hungry and the bag was stuck. I had to -
dialogue.zh: 我真的很饿，那袋东西卡住了。我只好——

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: That's all from News Channel XYZ. This is Guy Newsman saying goodbye.
dialogue.zh: XYZ 新闻频道的报道到此结束。我是盖伊·纽斯曼，再见。

dialogue.speaker: Guy
dialogue.en: Okay, we have to find ourselves another story, guys.
dialogue.zh: 好，伙计们，我们得再给自己找个新闻。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time! Hi Mom!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！嗨，妈妈！

quiz.prompt: What was Anna doing when the crime started?
Why did the robbers get kicked off the bus?
Where did Anna really hurt her arm?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 43
lessons.subtitle: Time for Plan B

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey there! Tonight, I am teaching my ukulele class. It is far away. So, I am going to ride the Metro. Oh, no! I lost my wallet! It has my Metro card, my credit card and my money! Oh, no!
dialogue.zh: 嘿！今晚我要去教尤克里里课。地方很远。所以我打算坐地铁。哦，不！我的钱包丢了！里面有地铁卡、信用卡和钱！哦，不！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's times like this I remember my father's important words. He said, "Anna, never … " No wait, "Always have emergency money." It's empty. Time for Plan B. Extra Emergency Money.
dialogue.zh: 这种时候我会想起爸爸的重要话。他说：“安娜，永远不要……”不对，“要一直备着应急钱。”空的。该用 B 计划了。额外应急钱。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No! It's empty too! Anna, it's time for Plan C.
dialogue.zh: 不！也是空的！安娜，该用 C 计划了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi Anna. What's up?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜。怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm stuck downtown without any money. Would you be able to come downtown? Please?
dialogue.zh: 我困在市中心，一点钱都没有。你能来市中心吗？拜托？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, I can't. I'm too busy. I have to give a big presentation in one hour. Sorry!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我去不了。我太忙了。一小时后我有一个重要演示。抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That's ok. Good luck with your presentation!
dialogue.zh: 没关系。祝你演示顺利！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Thanks!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Time for Plan D.
dialogue.zh: 该用 D 计划了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Jonathan! How's it going?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，乔纳森！最近怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna. Things are great. What's up?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜。挺好的。怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I was wondering if you could give me some money.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我在想你能不能给我一点钱。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.zh: 什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: See, I lost my wallet and I'm stuck downtown and I --
dialogue.zh: 是这样，我的钱包丢了，我困在市中心，而且我——

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Anna, I wish I could. I'm at the airport with my mother. Her flight leaves in two hours.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我也想帮。我在机场陪我妈妈。她的航班两小时后起飞。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That's okay. Tell your Mom to have a nice trip!
dialogue.zh: 没关系。代我祝你妈妈旅途愉快！

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I do wish I could help. Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 我真希望能帮上忙。谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bye.
dialogue.zh: 再见。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is serious. Time for … Plan E.
dialogue.zh: 这下严重了。该用……E 计划了。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Hello.
dialogue.zh: 喂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Ashley! What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！你在做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Oh! Hi Anna!
dialogue.zh: 哦！嗨，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ashley, I was wondering, uh, would you be able to come downtown? And could you give me $20?
dialogue.zh: 阿什莉，我在想，嗯，你能来市中心吗？还能给我 20 美元吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, I can't.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我去不了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'll pay you back the money. I promise.
dialogue.zh: 钱我会还你的。我保证。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, I'm not worried about the money. I'm babysitting. That was very, very, bad!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我担心的不是钱。我在带孩子。刚才那样非常、非常不好！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, losing your wallet is bad, but it's not the end of the world, Ashley.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，丢钱包是不好，但还没到世界末日，阿什莉。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I was talking to my niece, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我是在对我侄女说话，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, thanks anyway, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 好吧，还是谢谢你，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Good luck getting money.
dialogue.zh: 祝你顺利弄到钱。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good luck babysitting!
dialogue.zh: 祝你带孩子顺利！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, Plans A, B, C, D and E did not work. Think, Anna, think. Time for Plan F.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，A、B、C、D、E 计划都没用。想一想，安娜，想一想。该用 F 计划了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Won't you give, could -- Thank you very much, sir! -- would you give me money, won't you give -- Thank you very much! -- could you give, won't you give me money -- until next time! -- won't you give me money?
dialogue.zh: 你愿不愿意给，能不能——非常感谢您，先生！——你愿不愿意给我钱，你愿不愿意给——非常感谢！——能不能给，愿不愿意给我钱——下次见！——愿不愿意给我钱？

quiz.prompt: What did Anna lose?
Why can't Marsha come downtown?
What is Anna's Plan F?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 44
lessons.subtitle: Making Healthy Choices

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there, Ashley!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，阿什莉！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna! Hi! Where are you going?
dialogue.zh: 安娜！嗨！你去哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What was that?
dialogue.zh: 那是什么声音？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm hungry. When I'm hungry, I only want to eat junk food! But I know I should eat healthy food. So, I fight with myself. One side says, 'You should eat healthy food.' The other side says, 'But I want to eat junk food!'
dialogue.zh: 我饿了。我饿的时候只想吃垃圾食品！可我知道我该吃健康食物。所以我和自己打架。一边说：‘你应该吃健康食物。’另一边说：‘可我想吃垃圾食品！’

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Well, Anna, go to the Giant supermarket. You should be able to find all kinds of food there - for all of you.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，安娜，去 Giant 超市。你应该能在那儿找到各种各样的食物——给你们所有人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good idea, Ashley. See you later!
dialogue.zh: 好主意，阿什莉。回头见！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Bye, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 再见，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! This supermarket is huge! Look at all of these fruits and vegetables! I should eat more vegetables.
dialogue.zh: 哇！这家超市好大！看看这些水果和蔬菜！我应该多吃蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Good idea, Anna. You must eat more vegetables … like celery!
dialogue.zh: 好主意，安娜。你必须多吃蔬菜……比如芹菜！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Celery?! Do you know what the web says about celery?
dialogue.zh: 芹菜？！你知道网上怎么说芹菜吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, what?
dialogue.zh: 不知道，怎么说？

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Celery is 95 percent water - 100 percent NOT ice cream. I love the web!
dialogue.zh: 芹菜 95% 是水——100% 不是冰淇淋。我爱互联网！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Anna, you mustn't eat junk food. Junk food will kill you.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你千万别吃垃圾食品。垃圾食品会害了你。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: You are being silly.
dialogue.zh: 你真傻。

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: No, you are!
dialogue.zh: 不，你才傻！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: No, you are.
dialogue.zh: 不，你才是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Will you two please be nice to each other? It is important to eat healthy foods. But, a little junk food will not kill me. Hmm, ice cream. Ice cream does sound good.
dialogue.zh: 你们两个能不能对对方好一点？吃健康食物很重要。可是，一点点垃圾食品不会害了我。嗯，冰淇淋。冰淇淋听起来确实不错。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Take this cart to the frozen food aisle!
dialogue.zh: 把这辆购物车推到冷冻食品区！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: No wait, go back! Go back! We forgot fruit. Go back!!
dialogue.zh: 等等，回去！回去！我们忘了水果。回去！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, we are in the frozen food aisle!
dialogue.zh: 好，我们到冷冻食品区了！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Mmm, ice cream!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，冰淇淋！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Mmm, frozen peas!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，冷冻豌豆！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Nobody says, 'Mmm, frozen peas.' They say, 'Mmm, ice cream!'
dialogue.zh: 没人会说‘嗯，冷冻豌豆’。他们说‘嗯，冰淇淋！’

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am not going to tell you two again! Stop fighting!
dialogue.zh: 我不会再说第二遍了！别吵了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I smell fresh bread! I love the smells of a bakery!
dialogue.zh: 我闻到新鲜面包了！我爱面包店的味道！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Oh, Anna, let's buy a fresh loaf of whole wheat, organic bread!
dialogue.zh: 哦，安娜，我们买一条新鲜的全麦有机面包吧！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: You don't have to buy bread. Buy some donuts, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 你不必买面包。买些甜甜圈，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: You mustn't buy donuts. They are only fat and sugar.
dialogue.zh: 你千万别买甜甜圈。它们只有脂肪和糖。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Exactly! You know, you are really no fun at all.
dialogue.zh: 没错！你知道吗，你一点都不好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: And you must think having high cholesterol is fun.
dialogue.zh: 那你一定觉得胆固醇高很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Everyone likes donuts! That is why you don't have friends!
dialogue.zh: 人人都喜欢甜甜圈！所以你才没有朋友！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: And that is why your cholesterol is so high!
dialogue.zh: 所以你的胆固醇才那么高！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: My cholesterol is none of your business!!
dialogue.zh: 我的胆固醇不关你的事！！

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: And I have lots of friends!!
dialogue.zh: 而且我有很多朋友！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Stop it! Stop it! Stop it! I am sick and tired of the both of you!!
dialogue.zh: 停下！停下！停下！我受够你们两个了！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know what you two need!
dialogue.zh: 我知道你们两个需要什么！

dialogue.speaker: Junky
dialogue.en: Anna! What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 安娜！你在干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Healthy
dialogue.en: Put me down!
dialogue.zh: 放下我！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You two need to cool off!
dialogue.zh: 你们两个需要冷静一下！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am going to go buy my healthy food and my junk food! Good bye!
dialogue.zh: 我要去买我的健康食物和垃圾食品了！再见！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time …
dialogue.zh: 下次见……

quiz.prompt: Where does Ashley tell Anna to shop?
What does Healthy say Anna must eat more of?
What does Anna buy at the end?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 45
lessons.subtitle: This Land is Your Land

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know I love Washington, D.C. But I want to see more of the United States. My roommate Marsha and I will be on vacation at the same time. So, we are going on a road trip together!
dialogue.zh: 你知道我爱华盛顿特区。可我想看看更多的美国。室友玛莎和我会在同一时间休假。所以，我们要一起公路旅行！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 嗨，玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I packed my bags and I am ready to go!
dialogue.zh: 我行李打包好了，准备出发！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Did you make a list of all the places you want to see?
dialogue.zh: 你把想去的地方都列清单了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did. I want to see New York City and the Statue of Liberty!
dialogue.zh: 列了。我想看纽约市和自由女神像！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And I want to see Mount Rushmore!
dialogue.zh: 我想看拉什莫尔山！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mount Rushmore.
dialogue.zh: 拉什莫尔山。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And don't forget the Grand Canyon!
dialogue.zh: 还有，别忘了大峡谷！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's not forget California's redwood forest! There are so many places to see!
dialogue.zh: 也别忘了加州的红杉林！要看的地方太多了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We will be driving for a long time. So, we might get bored.
dialogue.zh: 我们会开很久。所以，我们可能会无聊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Bored? No way! We can talk.
dialogue.zh: 无聊？才不会！我们可以聊天。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Or not talk.
dialogue.zh: 或者不聊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can play word games. We can sing! You know, our trip is like that famous American song. "This land is your land, This land is my land …"
dialogue.zh: 我们可以玩文字游戏。我们可以唱歌！你知道，我们的旅行就像那首著名的美国歌。“这土地是你的，这土地是我的……”

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: "…from California to the New York island ..."
dialogue.zh: “……从加州到纽约岛……”

dialogue.speaker: Anna and Marsha
dialogue.en: "... to the redwood forest to the Gulf stream waters ... this land was made for you and me!"
dialogue.zh: “……到红杉林，到墨西哥湾流……这土地是为你和我而造的！”

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Will we be stopping soon?
dialogue.zh: 我们很快会停一下吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We won't be stopping soon.
dialogue.zh: 我们不会很快停。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'm hungry.
dialogue.zh: 我饿了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, we just left D.C.! We'll be eating lunch in about 2 hours. Can you wait?
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我们刚离开华盛顿特区！大约 2 小时后才吃午饭。你能等吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I guess.
dialogue.zh: 那就等吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here, have an apple. It's organic!
dialogue.zh: 给，吃个苹果。是有机的！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Okay, we will be arriving in New York City very soon!
dialogue.zh: 好，我们很快就要到纽约市了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can't wait to see The Big Apple! Marsha, look! There she is!
dialogue.zh: 我等不及要看大苹果城了！玛莎，看！她在那儿！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: The Statue of Liberty!
dialogue.zh: 自由女神像！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She is awesome!
dialogue.zh: 她太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, in ten minutes, guess what we'll be seeing?
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，再过十分钟，猜我们会看到什么？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.zh: 什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The largest rocking chair in the world!
dialogue.zh: 世界上最大的摇椅！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: No, we won't be seeing that.
dialogue.zh: 不，我们不会去看那个。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, it's on my other list -- Best Roadside Sights.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，它在我另一份清单上——最佳路边景观。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh no! We littered! And my list is gone. Don't worry. I brought the book.
dialogue.zh: 哦不！我们乱丢垃圾了！我的清单也没了。别担心。我带了这本书。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … and that is why I am so afraid of sheep.
dialogue.zh: ……所以我才那么怕羊。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow, I feel better. Marsha, you are a great listener.
dialogue.zh: 哇，我感觉好多了。玛莎，你真是个很好的倾听者。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Where are we?
dialogue.zh: 我们在哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We will be entering North Dakota any minute now!
dialogue.zh: 我们马上就要进入北达科他州了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: North Dakota! We are going in the wrong direction! We want to go to South Dakota!
dialogue.zh: 北达科他州！我们走错方向了！我们要去南达科他州！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No problem. I will just exit the highway. We will be going south … in just a minute. There. Done! We're going south! Okay, we will be stopping for gas and a bathroom break in about an hour.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。我这就下高速。我们马上……往南走。好了。完成！我们在往南了！好，大约一小时后我们会停下来加油和上厕所。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Then we will be very near to Mount Rushmore!
dialogue.zh: 然后我们就很靠近拉什莫尔山了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yay! Dead presidents' heads on the side of a mountain!
dialogue.zh: 耶！山上的已故总统头像！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We did it, Marsha! We made it to California! It's beautiful!
dialogue.zh: 我们做到了，玛莎！我们到加州了！真美！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: And we saw everything on the list!
dialogue.zh: 而且清单上的都看到了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, we saw everything on page 1 of the list.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我们看完了清单第 1 页上的所有地方。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What do you mean "page 1?"
dialogue.zh: “第 1 页”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Here are pages 2, 3 and 4! We'll be very busy driving back to Washington, D.C. Until next time … !
dialogue.zh: 哦。这儿还有第 2、3、4 页！我们开车回华盛顿特区会很忙。下次见……！

quiz.prompt: Who goes on the road trip with Anna?
Which famous song do they sing?
Which state do they enter by mistake?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 46
lessons.subtitle: May I Borrow That?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Have a nice day at work Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 上班愉快，玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: You too, Anna. Oh, wait. Do you have pen and paper I can borrow?
dialogue.zh: 你也是，安娜。哦，等一下。你有笔和纸可以借我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course.
dialogue.zh: 当然。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We are meeting at this restaurant tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我们今晚在这家餐厅见面。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What is happening tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚有什么事？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Today is my birthday. We are celebrating at 7pm tonight. Did you forget?
dialogue.zh: 今天是我的生日。我们今晚 7 点庆祝。你忘了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry, Marsha! I gotta go! See you later!
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，玛莎！我得走了！回头见！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Don't forget! Tonight … 7pm!
dialogue.zh: 别忘了！今晚……7 点！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I forgot Marsha’s birthday! And I don’t get my paycheck until next week. I know. I'll make her a gift. I’ll just have to borrow a couple of things.
dialogue.zh: 我忘了玛莎的生日！而且我下周才发工资。我知道了。我给她做一份礼物。我只要借几样东西就行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Amelia, may I borrow your stapler?
dialogue.zh: 阿米莉亚，我可以借你的订书机吗？

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Sure. I can lend you my stapler, Anna. But please return it. It’s my favorite stapler.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我可以借给你订书机，安娜。但请还回来。这是我最喜欢的订书机。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You can trust me. I understand. One time, I loaned my stapler to the wrong person.
dialogue.zh: 你可以相信我。我懂。有一次，我把订书机借给了不该借的人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Amelia.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，阿米莉亚。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Don’t mention it. Bye, stapler!
dialogue.zh: 不客气。再见，订书机！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Jonathan! Can I borrow your scissors?
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森！我可以借你的剪刀吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Oh! Hi, Anna! What’re you doing?
dialogue.zh: 哦！嗨，安娜！你在干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can I borrow your scissors? Sorry to bother you.
dialogue.zh: 我可以借你的剪刀吗？抱歉打扰你。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Yes, I can lend them to you, but you must return them. These scissors -- they are the sharpest scissors in the office. Watch.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我可以借给你，但你必须还回来。这把剪刀——是办公室里最锋利的。看。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow, those are sharp. I will be very careful.
dialogue.zh: 哇，真锋利。我会非常小心。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And I’ll bring them back tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我明天会还回来。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Good.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: You're welcome.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Happy Birthday, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 生日快乐，玛莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna! I love birthday gifts! Anna, it is … interesting. What is it?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，安娜！我爱生日礼物！安娜，它……挺有意思的。这是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I know you love hats. And you need office supplies. So, this is your own office supply hat!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我知道你爱帽子。而且你需要办公用品。所以，这是你专属的办公用品帽！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Wow! That is a lot of office supplies!
dialogue.zh: 哇！好多办公用品！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Many people loaned or shared their supplies with me. Some people really love their office supplies. It has paper, pens, tape, erasers, rubber bands, binder clips, paper clips, and a light!
dialogue.zh: 很多人把用品借给我或和我分享。有些人真的很爱他们的办公用品。上面有纸、笔、胶带、橡皮、橡皮筋、长尾夹、回形针，还有一盏灯！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What is the balloon for?
dialogue.zh: 气球是干什么的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The balloon will help your friends find you. Let’s try it! You get a seat in the restaurant - I will find you!
dialogue.zh: 气球能帮朋友找到你。我们试试！你在餐厅找个座位——我会找到你！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sometimes all the money in the world can’t buy the perfect gift. Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 有时候全世界的钱也买不到完美的礼物。下次见！

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 47
lessons.subtitle: How Can I Help?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Pete. What are you doing?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，皮特。你在干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Oh! Hi, Anna. Right now, I am fixing my car.
dialogue.zh: 哦！嗨，安娜。我现在在修车。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How’s it going?
dialogue.zh: 怎么样了？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It’s going … not so good.
dialogue.zh: 进展……不太好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How can I help? I was planning to visit some friends. But if you need help, I can help. I like helping.
dialogue.zh: 我能帮什么忙？我本来打算去看朋友。但如果你需要帮忙，我可以帮。我喜欢帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, I can fix it myself. But thanks.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我自己能修好。不过谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, I think I found your problem. These are spark plugs. They start the engine.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，我想我找到问题了。这些是火花塞。它们用来启动引擎。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I know that, Anna. But there were too many spark plugs … in there. So I took out the extra ones.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，安娜。可里面火花塞太多了……所以我把多余的拿出来了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are no extras, Pete. You need all of them. Pete, can you fix a car yourself?
dialogue.zh: 没有多余的，皮特。你全都需要。皮特，你能自己修车吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, Anna, last night I was watching the online video course, “You CAN Fix a Car Yourself!”
dialogue.zh: 嗯，安娜，昨晚我在看网课，《你也能自己修车！》

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Yes, you CAN fix your car yourself!
dialogue.zh: 是的，你也能自己修车！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And I watched the first 10 lessons. So, I think I know what I’m doing.
dialogue.zh: 而且我看了前 10 课。所以我觉得我知道自己在做什么。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How many lessons are there?
dialogue.zh: 一共有多少课？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Four hundred and fifty.
dialogue.zh: 四百五十课。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: 450! That'll take too long! If I fix your car, I'll have it running in 10 to 15 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 450 课！那太久了！要是我来修，10 到 15 分钟就能让它跑起来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where’re your tools?
dialogue.zh: 你的工具在哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I have this. And this.
dialogue.zh: 我有这个。还有这个。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great. Um, I’ll get my tools. I’ll be back in a flash!
dialogue.zh: 很好。嗯，我去拿我的工具。我马上回来！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: But, Anna, I don’t need your help.
dialogue.zh: 可是，安娜，我不需要你帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, when I was a teenager, I was fixing cars -- myself. I learned from a master.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，我十几岁的时候就自己修车。我跟一位师傅学的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You can trust me.
dialogue.zh: 你可以相信我。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Great! But we need teamwork. You sit in the car. When I say “go,” you start the engine.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！但我们需要配合。你坐在车里。我说“走”，你就启动引擎。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, go!
dialogue.zh: 好，走！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Stop!
dialogue.zh: 停！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, go! Huh.
dialogue.zh: 好，走！嗯？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: It's not starting! It’s not starting!
dialogue.zh: 发动不了！发动不了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What’s wrong?
dialogue.zh: 怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: This car is stupid … stupid, stupid!
dialogue.zh: 这车太笨了……笨，笨！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, kicking the tires will not help.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，踢轮胎没用。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, you did not help, Anna. You did not help!!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你也没帮上忙，安娜。你没帮上忙！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, Pete! Pull yourself together, man. Give me the keys. I must feel the key in the ignition and turn it myself.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，皮特！冷静一点。把钥匙给我。我必须自己把钥匙插进点火开关再转动。

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.en: Use the key, Anna. Turn the key, Anna. What are you forgetting, Anna?
dialogue.zh: 用钥匙，安娜。转动钥匙，安娜。你忘了什么，安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete. Pete.
dialogue.zh: 皮特。皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.zh: 什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You are out of gas.
dialogue.zh: 你没油了。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I can’t be out of gas. I’m out of gas. Sorry, Anna. I’ll go get some.
dialogue.zh: 不可能没油。我没油了。抱歉，安娜。我去加油。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete. You relax. Clean your face. You can watch the rest of your online video course. It’ll be faster if I go … in a flash. Until next time …
dialogue.zh: 皮特。你休息。把脸擦干净。你可以继续看网课。我去会更快……一转眼就回来。下次见……

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Lesson 11. Always make sure you have a full tank of gas!
dialogue.zh: 第 11 课。一定要确保油箱是满的！

How many lessons are in the video course?
Why won't the car start?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 48
lessons.subtitle: Have You Ever ...?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! I have lived in Washington, D.C. for a long time now. And I have done a lot. I feel that I know this city pretty well. That's the wrong way. Where is it again?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我在华盛顿特区住了很久了。我也做了很多事。我觉得自己挺了解这座城市。走错路了。它在哪儿来着？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me, can I help you? Have we met before?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，需要帮忙吗？我们以前见过吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I don’t think so. I’ve just flown in from Boston. My name is Jean.
dialogue.zh: 应该没有。我刚从波士顿飞来。我叫吉恩。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi, Jean! I'm Anna. I really feel like we’ve met before. Anyway, how can I help?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，吉恩！我是安娜。我真觉得我们见过。不过，我能帮什么忙？

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I want to see an interesting museum but I don’t know which one.
dialogue.zh: 我想看一个有意思的博物馆，但不知道选哪一个。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I can help with that. I’ve lived in Washington, D.C. a long time. I think I’ve seen all the museums.
dialogue.zh: 这个我能帮。我在华盛顿特区住了很久。我想博物馆我都看过了。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: Wow, thanks. So, tell me, which museums are good?
dialogue.zh: 哇，谢谢。那告诉我，哪些博物馆好？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, they are all good. But they’re all different. There are science museums and history museums and art and culture museums.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，都很好。但各不一样。有科学博物馆、历史博物馆，还有艺术和文化博物馆。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I want to see an unusual museum.
dialogue.zh: 我想看一个特别的博物馆。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I like the Sculpture Garden. Have you ever seen sculptures in a garden? It is really artistic!
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢雕塑花园。你见过花园里的雕塑吗？非常有艺术感！

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I have never seen a garden of sculptures! I’ll write that on my list!
dialogue.zh: 我从没见过雕塑花园！我要写到清单上！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Have you been to the Museum of the American Indian? I’ve visited that museum many times. It is very peaceful.
dialogue.zh: 你去过美国印第安人博物馆吗？我去过很多次。那里很安静。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I have always liked American Indian culture.
dialogue.zh: 我一直喜欢美国印第安文化。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I’ll put that on my list. Do you have any other suggestions?
dialogue.zh: 我把它写上。你还有别的建议吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, if you like plants, you can visit the U.S. Botanic Gardens. It's very organic.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，如果你喜欢植物，可以去美国植物园。非常天然。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: I have always loved plants. I’ll write that on my list, too! Wow, you know so much about D.C.’s museums.
dialogue.zh: 我一直爱植物。这个也写上！哇，你对特区的博物馆了解真多。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I have lived here for over a year.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我在这儿住一年多了。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: You’re so lucky to live in such a beautiful city filled with so many museums and a zoo!
dialogue.zh: 你真幸运，住在这么美的城市，有这么多博物馆，还有动物园！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What? D.C. has a zoo?
dialogue.zh: 什么？华盛顿特区有动物园？

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: Yes, and it’s beautiful. You’ve lived here for so long and you haven’t been to the zoo?
dialogue.zh: 有，而且很美。你住这么久，还没去过动物园？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I've never been to D.C.’s zoo. I've never been to any zoos!
dialogue.zh: 我从没去过特区的动物园。我从没去过任何动物园！

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: You have never seen zoo animals?
dialogue.zh: 你从没见过动物园的动物？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I grew up on a farm, Jean. I've known farm animals my whole life.
dialogue.zh: 我在农场长大，吉恩。我一辈子都认识农场动物。

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: But the zoo has lions and elephants and zebras! If you have never seen a real, live elephant, you must. They are so majestic.
dialogue.zh: 可动物园有狮子、大象和斑马！如果你从没见过真正活着的大象，一定要去。它们太威风了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I will. I will! There. I’ve written my own must-see zoo animal list!
dialogue.zh: 我会去。我会去！好了。我写好了自己的必看动物园动物清单！

dialogue.speaker: Jean
dialogue.en: Have fun at the zoo and thanks, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 在动物园玩得开心，谢谢你，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Have fun at the museums, Jean! And thank YOU!
dialogue.zh: 在博物馆玩得开心，吉恩！也谢谢你！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This has been awesome! And I have seen every animal on my list! Jean, the tourist, helped me see more of my city. But where have I seen her before?
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！清单上的动物我都看到了！游客吉恩帮我看到了更多这座城市。可我以前在哪儿见过她？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh well. Until next time …
dialogue.zh: 算了。下次见……

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 49
lessons.subtitle: Operation Spy!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It is no secret that Washington, D.C. has spies. Well, it should be a secret because spying is secret. But it’s not a secret. There’s even a spy museum! The International Spy Museum has created an amazing collection of spy things! And today, we will see them! My boss, Ms. Weaver, has sent me here … on a mission!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区有间谍，这不是秘密。嗯，这本该是秘密，因为间谍活动是秘密的。可它不是秘密。这儿甚至有一座间谍博物馆！国际间谍博物馆收藏了很多了不起的间谍物品！今天我们就去看！我的老板韦弗女士派我来这儿……执行任务！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna, are you there?
dialogue.zh: 喂，安娜，你在吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s her. Yes, Agent Peacock. This is Agent Flamingo, reporting for duty.
dialogue.zh: 是她。是的，孔雀特工。我是火烈鸟特工，报到。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Agent what? Look, Anna … I mean, Agent Flamingo, I want you to learn all you can about spying.
dialogue.zh: 什么特工？听着，安娜……我是说，火烈鸟特工，我要你尽量多了解间谍活动。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You mean, collect intelligence?
dialogue.zh: 你是说，收集情报？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yeah, it’s for our new show -- “D.C. Secrets.”
dialogue.zh: 对，是给我们的新节目——《特区秘密》。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You've got it, Agent Peacock. The mission is safe with me.
dialogue.zh: 明白，孔雀特工。任务包在我身上。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Oh, okay, great. Just be back by noon.
dialogue.zh: 哦，好，很好。中午之前回来就行。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Agent Peacock, I’m at an air duct!
dialogue.zh: 孔雀特工，我到通风管了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, spies sometimes sneak down air ducts.
dialogue.zh: 是的，间谍有时会从通风管悄悄爬下去。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have never snuck down an air duct. It’s dark and small. I’m afraid of dark, small places.
dialogue.zh: 我从没从通风管爬下去过。又黑又小。我怕又黑又小的地方。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You can do it, Agent Flamingo. You know, spies aren’t afraid of a little darkness.
dialogue.zh: 你能行的，火烈鸟特工。你知道，间谍不怕一点点黑暗。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Right. It’s just an air duct -- a dark, small air duct. Okay. I’m doing it, Agent Peacock! I am sneaking down a long, dark, small air duct. I’m having a little trouble breathing.
dialogue.zh: 对。只是一根通风管——又黑又小的通风管。好。我在做了，孔雀特工！我正沿着又长又黑又小的通风管往下爬。我呼吸有点困难。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Just keep going, Agent Flamingo. Think of the team!
dialogue.zh: 继续往前，火烈鸟特工。想想团队！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay, I will think of the team. I’m thinking of the team, Agent Peacock! I did it! I did it! I sneaked down an air duct. That was a little uncomfortable.
dialogue.zh: 好，我会想着团队。我在想着团队，孔雀特工！我做到了！我做到了！我从通风管爬下来了。有点不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Good!
dialogue.zh: 好！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What's the next mission?
dialogue.zh: 下一个任务是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Umm … have you ever cracked a code?
dialogue.zh: 嗯……你破译过密码吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Well, go learn. Spies use their brains.
dialogue.zh: 那就去学。间谍靠脑子。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it! I’ve never cracked a code before. Let’s try, Agent Flamingo! This is really hard. I'm still trying to crack the code. I've cracked the code! I've cracked the code, Agent Peacock! My brain really hurts.
dialogue.zh: 明白！我以前从没破译过密码。试试吧，火烈鸟特工！这真难。我还在试着破译。我破译了！我破译了，孔雀特工！我的脑子真疼。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Great. Umm, Agent Flamingo, now answer this question: Do spies have to be in good shape?
dialogue.zh: 很好。嗯，火烈鸟特工，现在回答这个问题：间谍必须身体好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: “Yes,” Agent Peacock! Spies have to be in really good shape! Can you hear me?
dialogue.zh: “是的”，孔雀特工！间谍必须身体非常好！你听得见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You’re breaking up, Flamingo.
dialogue.zh: 信号不好，火烈鸟。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The International Spy Museum is awesome! Agent Peacock, I completed the mission!
dialogue.zh: 国际间谍博物馆太棒了！孔雀特工，我完成任务了！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Great. Great. Now, I have another very important mission for you.
dialogue.zh: 很好。很好。现在，我还有一个非常重要的任务给你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Got it. See you back at H.Q.!
dialogue.zh: 明白。总部见！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yummy! You brought my lunch! Thanks, Agent Flamingo!
dialogue.zh: 好吃！你把我的午饭带来了！谢谢，火烈鸟特工！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mission completed. Agent Peacock!
dialogue.zh: 任务完成。孔雀特工！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Don't ask.
dialogue.zh: 别问。

What does Anna sneak down?
What is Ms. Weaver's last mission for Anna?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 50
lessons.subtitle: Back to School

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, and welcome to Georgetown University in Washington, D.C.! I am going back to school! Georgetown is the oldest Catholic and Jesuit university in the United States. The Jesuits are a religious order known worldwide for their many colleges and universities. Students have been studying here since 1792!
dialogue.zh: 你好，欢迎来到华盛顿特区的乔治城大学！我要重返校园了！乔治城是美国最古老的天主教耶稣会大学。耶稣会是一个宗教修会，因创办许多学院和大学而闻名世界。学生们从 1792 年起就在这里学习！

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Hey, are you finished with your report?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，你的报告写完了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Taylor
dialogue.en: Almost. I have been writing and re-writing since last night! The subject is really interesting to me.
dialogue.zh: 快了。我从昨晚就开始写了又写！这个主题我真的很感兴趣。

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: Me too! I have been studying this topic for a long time.
dialogue.zh: 我也是！这个题目我研究很久了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Am I late?
dialogue.zh: 我迟到了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: You’re a little late. But don’t worry. The professor isn’t here yet.
dialogue.zh: 你晚了一点。不过别担心。教授还没到。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How long has the class been waiting?
dialogue.zh: 全班等了多久了？

dialogue.speaker: Taylor
dialogue.en: We’ve only been waiting for about 10 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我们才等了大约 10 分钟。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh good. Oh, no! I forgot my pencil sharpener. Excuse me, do you have a pencil sharpener I can borrow?
dialogue.zh: 哦，还好。哦，不！我忘带卷笔刀了。不好意思，你有卷笔刀可以借我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Taylor
dialogue.en: No, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 没有，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh wait. I found my extra one! Whew, that was close.
dialogue.zh: 哦，等一下。我找到备用的了！呼，好险。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, how long have you been studying at Georgetown?
dialogue.zh: 那你在乔治城学习多久了？

dialogue.speaker: Andrew
dialogue.en: I’ve been studying here since 2015.
dialogue.zh: 我从 2015 年起就在这儿学习。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome. You know, I've been wanting to go back to school for a long time. So, here I am!
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。你知道，我想回学校很久了。所以，我来了！

dialogue.speaker: Andrew
dialogue.en: Well, you picked a great school. I’ve been really happy here.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你选了所好学校。我在这儿一直很开心。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome. See, I’ve been working for several years now. So, going back to school makes me a little nervous.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。你看，我已经工作好几年了。所以回学校让我有点紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Randall
dialogue.en: Don’t be nervous. Just pay attention and do your best!
dialogue.zh: 别紧张。只要专心听，尽力就好！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is great advice. You know, I have been paying attention. But sometimes I still feel like I don’t understand. Like last week …
dialogue.zh: 这建议真好。你知道，我一直在专心听。但有时我还是觉得没听懂。就像上周……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What’s that?
dialogue.zh: 那是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Jada
dialogue.en: This is my draft.
dialogue.zh: 这是我的草稿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What draft?
dialogue.zh: 什么草稿？

dialogue.speaker: Jada
dialogue.en: The professor told us to bring our drafts.
dialogue.zh: 教授让我们带草稿来。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I think she said “giraffe.”
dialogue.zh: 我以为她说的是“长颈鹿”。

dialogue.speaker: Jada
dialogue.en: No. She didn’t.
dialogue.zh: 不。她没那么说。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here comes the professor.
dialogue.zh: 教授来了。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Jones
dialogue.en: Hello class! Sorry I'm late, but the snow storm made getting here really difficult. I see you’ve been waiting very patiently. So, let’s get started! Who wants to give their talk first?
dialogue.zh: 同学们好！抱歉我迟到了，暴风雪让过来很困难。我看你们等得很有耐心。那我们开始吧！谁想先做报告？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! Oh! Please, please pick me.
dialogue.zh: 哦！哦！请选我，请选我。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Jones
dialogue.en: Anna?
dialogue.zh: 安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Who me? Sure. Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 谁，我？当然。谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here is my report on “Violins in the City.”
dialogue.zh: 这是我的报告：《城市里的小提琴》。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: People have been looking for a solution to the problem of violins in the city. I say stop! Stop! They are not the problem! In fact, violins are part of the solution!
dialogue.zh: 人们一直在找解决城市小提琴问题的办法。我说停下！停下！它们不是问题！其实，小提琴是解决方案的一部分！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Violins create beautiful music that can fill a city with hope.
dialogue.zh: 小提琴能奏出美妙的音乐，让一座城市充满希望。

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Jones
dialogue.en: Anna …
dialogue.zh: 安娜……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: If we put a violin in the hands of every child …
dialogue.zh: 如果我们让每个孩子手里都有一把小提琴……

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Jones
dialogue.en: Anna! The topic is “Violence in the city.” Violence. Not violins.
dialogue.zh: 安娜！题目是《城市里的暴力》。暴力。不是小提琴。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time … Like I was saying, many people are saying that violence in the city is a problem. A very big problem.
dialogue.zh: 下次见……就像我刚才说的，很多人都说城市里的暴力是个问题。一个非常大的问题。

quiz.prompt: Where is Anna going back to school?
What did the professor tell students to bring?
What is the real topic of the report?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 51
lessons.subtitle: A Good Habit

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: D.C. is a popular city for marathons! A marathon is a long race. Many marathons raise money for charity, you know - good works. A marathon is a good fitness goal too. I want to challenge myself in a marathon and maybe win a medal! Hey, there's Ashley. Ashley! Wait for me! It's Anna!
dialogue.zh: 华盛顿特区很适合跑马拉松！马拉松是一场很长的比赛。很多马拉松是为慈善筹款，也就是做好事。马拉松也是很好的健身目标。我想挑战自己跑一场马拉松，也许还能赢一枚奖牌！嘿，那是阿什莉。阿什莉！等等我！是安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ash ... ley. Ash ... ley.
dialogue.zh: 阿什……莉。阿什……莉。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Are you okay, Anna?
dialogue.zh: 你还好吗，安娜？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I just ran ... from over there.
dialogue.zh: 我刚从那边……跑过来。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Do you want to sit down, Anna? Do you want some water? No thanks. You keep it.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你想坐下吗？要喝点水吗？不用了。你留着吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. I didn't know you like to run.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我不知道你喜欢跑步。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: I love running. In fact, this weekend, I will run in my first marathon.
dialogue.zh: 我爱跑步。其实，这个周末我要跑人生第一场马拉松。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Me ... too.
dialogue.zh: 我……也是。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Really? You are running in a marathon?
dialogue.zh: 真的？你也要跑马拉松？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah. In a couple of days. Why do you ask ... like that?
dialogue.zh: 对。过几天。你为什么那样问……？

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What do you know about running in a marathon?
dialogue.zh: 你对跑马拉松了解多少？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know that there's a lot of running and sometimes you can win a medal.
dialogue.zh: 我知道要跑很多路，有时还能赢一枚奖牌。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: How long have you been training?
dialogue.zh: 你训练多久了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I started today. I've been training for an hour ... no, an hour and seven minutes!
dialogue.zh: 我今天才开始。我已经训练一个小时了……不，一个小时零七分钟！

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Anna, training a little every day is a good habit to get into. Not all at once!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，每天训练一点点才是好习惯。不要一次全练完！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for the advice, Ashley. But I'm running in a special race.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你的建议，阿什莉。不过我要跑的是一场特别的比赛。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: What marathon is it?
dialogue.zh: 是哪一场马拉松？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't remember the name. But the website said everyone gets a medal.
dialogue.zh: 我记不得名字了。但网站说每个人都能拿到奖牌。

dialogue.speaker: Ashley
dialogue.en: Okay, well, good luck, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 好吧，祝你好运，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ashley. Good luck to you, too.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，阿什莉。也祝你好运。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello. I am here to enter the race!
dialogue.zh: 你好。我来报名参赛！

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: But ma'am you can't enter the race.
dialogue.zh: 可是女士，你不能参加这场比赛。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What? How am I going to meet my goal?
dialogue.zh: 什么？那我怎么完成我的目标？

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: Ma'am, this race is for children. You can't run with the children.
dialogue.zh: 女士，这场比赛是给孩子的。你不能和孩子们一起跑。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Children? Children. That's perfect. I just might win!
dialogue.zh: 孩子？孩子。太完美了。我也许能赢！

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: No, ma'am. You really can't run with the children.
dialogue.zh: 不行，女士。你真的不能和孩子们一起跑。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. Of course. I was only thinking of my goal.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。当然。我只想着自己的目标了。

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.en: Well, you can help us with our goal, which is to raise money for sick children. Would you like to help us?
dialogue.zh: 那你可以帮我们完成目标，就是为生病的孩子筹款。你愿意帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I've just found my new goal. And I get to wear a medal. Good job!
dialogue.zh: 我刚找到了新目标。而且我还能戴奖牌。干得好！

quiz.prompt: What does Ashley say is a good habit?
choices: Running a marathon with no training

quiz.prompt: How long has Anna been training?
choices: For an hour and seven minutes

quiz.prompt: Why can't Anna enter the race?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Lesson 52
lessons.subtitle: Taking Chances

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, it's Anna! I did it - Washington, D.C. is my home. Looking back over the past year, I've done so many amazing things! I have met people from all over the world. I've made many good friends. And I have a great job! And I've taken a lot of chances. And now I have some really big news! Wait for it... and 3, 2, 1...
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是安娜！我做到了——华盛顿特区就是我的家。回望过去这一年，我做了很多了不起的事！我认识了来自世界各地的人。我交了很多好朋友。而且我有一份很棒的工作！我也试过很多次。现在我有个特别大的消息！等着……3、2、1……

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Hello and welcome to "Around the Corner and Across the Street from the Actor's Studio!" Many people dream of becoming actors. But very often, those dreams don't come true.
dialogue.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到《演员工作室街角对面》！很多人梦想成为演员。但那些梦想常常无法实现。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Well, today we will meet a woman and -- her acting career has really taken off. In fact, she acted in my play, "The Woods Are Alive!" Oh. She really brought the part of Tree Number 15 to life! Let's give a warm welcome to Anna Matteo!
dialogue.zh: 今天我们要见一位女士——她的演艺事业真的起飞了。其实，她演过我的话剧《树林活了！》。哦。她把15号树这个角色演活了！让我们热烈欢迎安娜·马特奥！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you. Thank you so much for having me here.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。非常感谢邀请我来。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Please, please, sit down. Here, here, let me help you.
dialogue.zh: 请坐，请坐。来，来，我帮你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. Thanks. Wow, it is great to see you again, Director Kelly!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，谢谢。哇，再次见到你真好，凯利导演！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: It's great to see you too, Anna. I see you are still wearing your tree costume. Does this have anything to do with your big news?
dialogue.zh: 见到你也很高兴，安娜。我看你还穿着树的服装。这和你的大消息有关吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes. Yes, it does.
dialogue.zh: 是的。有关。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Well, Anna, please share that news with us.
dialogue.zh: 那安娜，请跟我们分享这个消息吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Kelly, I will be acting in three movies.
dialogue.zh: 凯利，我将出演三部电影。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: That is amazing! Anna, tell us more.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！安娜，再多说一点。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, the first is a science fiction movie. The second is a romantic comedy. And the third is an action movie.
dialogue.zh: 第一部是科幻片。第二部是爱情喜剧。第三部是动作片。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: That is so great! Let me guess -- you're playing a tree in all of them!
dialogue.zh: 太好了！让我猜猜——你在这三部里都演一棵树！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! This is what happened. To prepare for your play, I had to find out what it was like to BE a tree in the world. I had to find out where to eat, where to shop, where to meet people and how to get around the city.
dialogue.zh: 对！事情是这样的。为了准备你的话剧，我得弄清楚在这个世界上当一棵树是什么感觉。我得弄清楚去哪里吃饭、去哪里购物、去哪里见人，还有怎么在城里走动。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Amazing. I think big things are going to happen for you, Anna. So, tell me, will you be moving to Hollywood for a career in movies?
dialogue.zh: 太厉害了。我觉得你要有大事发生了，安娜。那告诉我，你会搬去好莱坞发展电影事业吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. I'll make the movies and then come back. Washington, D.C. is my home.
dialogue.zh: 不会。我拍完电影就会回来。华盛顿特区才是我的家。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: I'm sure your family is very proud.
dialogue.zh: 我肯定你的家人非常骄傲。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, they are. You know, Kelly, not too long ago, I didn't feel very good about my life. I had to make a change. So, I took some chances. Sometimes I succeeded. Sometimes I failed. But I will never stop trying.
dialogue.zh: 是的。你知道，凯利，不久前我对生活感觉不太好。我必须做出改变。所以我试了一些机会。有时成功。有时失败。但我永远不会停止尝试。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Well, thank you for sharing your news and so much more with us, Anna. Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你和我们分享这个消息，还有这么多故事，安娜。下次见……

quiz.prompt: What part did Anna play in Kelly's play?
How many movies will Anna act in?
Will Anna move to Hollywood?
choices: No, she will come back to Washington, D.C.

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 1
lessons.subtitle: Budget Cuts

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hum. Oh! “Important meeting. Everyone must come.” Well, back to work! And my boss has called a meeting. I wonder what it's about. Maybe we're all getting raises! Ooo, there's Jonathan! Maybe he knows.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。哦！“重要会议。所有人都必须来。”好，回去干活！老板召集开会。不知道是什么事。也许我们都要加薪！哦，乔纳森在那儿！也许他知道。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm Professor Bot! This video is all about work. People talk about jobs and things that happen at work. Your assignment is to find as many work words as you can. Don't worry, I'll help.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我是机器人教授！这段视频都和工作有关。人们谈论工作和职场里发生的事。你的任务是尽量找出工作相关的词。别担心，我会帮你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, Jonathan, what do you think today's meeting is about? The email sounded important.
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森，你觉得今天的会是关于什么的？那封邮件听起来很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Well, I have heard people in the building talking about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 我听说大楼里有人在谈预算削减。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! Budget cuts? Wait, who has been talking about budget cuts?
dialogue.zh: 哦！预算削减？等等，谁在谈预算削减？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Mark in Accounting.
dialogue.zh: 会计部的马克。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not “people.”
dialogue.zh: 会计部的马克？那是一个人。那不叫“有人”。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I know, but Mark knows everything that goes on at The Studio.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，但马克对工作室里的事了如指掌。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is true. But wait, look at us. We shouldn't gossip. That's how rumors start. We'll just go to the meeting and see what happens.
dialogue.zh: 那倒是真的。可等等，看看我们。不该说闲话。谣言就是这样开始的。我们去开会，看看到底怎么回事。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: You're right. No more talk about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 你说得对。别再谈预算削减了。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Budget cuts? Oh no!
dialogue.zh: 预算削减？哦不！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I just heard Anna and Jonathan talking about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 我刚听到安娜和乔纳森在谈预算削减。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: That must be what the meeting is about. When there are budget cuts, people lose their jobs.
dialogue.zh: 会议一定就是这件事。有预算削减时，就会有人丢工作。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Not you. You're a good reporter.
dialogue.zh: 不会是你。你是个好记者。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: And it's not you. You've done a great job as a videographer.
dialogue.zh: 也不会是你。你当摄像师做得很好。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I can't go back to being a detective. Criminals scare me!
dialogue.zh: 我不能回去当侦探。罪犯吓到我！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: And I can't go back to being a teacher! High school kids scare me!
dialogue.zh: 我也不能回去当老师！高中生吓到我！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you hear any work words? They talked about a lot of jobs. You can make the name of a job by adding an ending to a verb! Kaveh reports, so, he's a reporter. Amelia used to detect, so she was a detective. If you teach, you're a teacher.
dialogue.zh: 你听到工作词了吗？他们谈了很多职业。在动词后面加词尾就能组成职业名！卡维报道新闻，所以他是记者。阿梅莉亚以前做侦探。如果你教书，你就是教师。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Penelope, have you heard the news? Today's meeting is about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，你听说了吗？今天的会是关于预算削减的。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: That's awful! What should I do?
dialogue.zh: 太糟了！我该怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Update your résumé. I’ve already updated mine. I’ll see you at the meeting.
dialogue.zh: 更新你的简历。我已经更新过了。会上见。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Hello everyone! Quiet, please. Quiet, please!
dialogue.zh: 大家好！请安静。请安静！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: This meeting won’t take long. Then you can all leave.
dialogue.zh: 这个会不会很长。然后你们都可以走。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: What is wrong with everyone? You look like I'm going to fire you. Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Seriously, what is wrong with everyone?
dialogue.zh: 大家怎么了？看起来像我要开除你们。哈哈哈！说真的，你们怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Ms. Weaver?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，韦弗女士？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 什么事，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, everyone has been worrying about, you know … We’ve been worrying that you are going to fire us!
dialogue.zh: 大家一直在担心，你知道……我们担心你要开除我们！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I’m not going to fire any of you! No! The reason for this meeting is to tell you what a good job you’ve been doing and give out new assignments. Budget cuts have been happening. But only one person has lost their job -- Mark in Accounting? Now, let’s talk about those new assignments.
dialogue.zh: 我不会开除你们任何人！不会！开会是为了告诉你们工作做得很好，并布置新任务。预算削减确实在发生。但只有一个人丢了工作——会计部的马克？现在，我们来谈那些新任务。

quiz.prompt: What rumor do people hear about the meeting?
Who has been talking about budget cuts?
What does Ms. Weaver actually do at the meeting?
choices: She praises the team and gives new assignments

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 2
lessons.subtitle: The Interview

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver is giving new assignments out. I am ready to take on anything she gives me. Well, except reporting traffic from a helicopter. Wish me luck.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士正在布置新任务。她给我什么我都准备好接下来。嗯，除了坐直升机报路况。祝我好运。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I wonder what Anna’s new assignment will be? Professor Bot here! While you are watching, look for phrasal, or two-word verbs. Some stay together, like “go back” and some can come apart, like “give [assignments] out.” Good luck, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 安娜的新任务会是什么？我是机器人教授！看的时候注意短语动词，也就是两个词的动词。有的不拆开，比如 go back；有的可以拆开，比如 give [assignments] out。加油，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: So, as I said at the meeting last week, I have new assignments for everyone at The Studio. Anna, you're good at asking questions. So, I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.
dialogue.zh: 就像我上周会上说的，我给工作室每个人都有新任务。安娜，你很会提问。所以我要你回去主持和报道。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That sounds great.
dialogue.zh: 听起来很棒。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: You're also a team player. So, I want you team up with someone ...
dialogue.zh: 你也很会团队合作。所以我要你和一个人搭档……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That sounds even better!
dialogue.zh: 听起来更好！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: ... someone who is very "different" from you.
dialogue.zh: ……一个和你非常“不一样”的人。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That sounds ... what do you mean "different"?
dialogue.zh: 听起来……“不一样”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Well, you are very cheerful, you're a people person. I want you to team up with someone who ... isn't.
dialogue.zh: 你很开朗，很会和人相处。我要你和一个……不是这样的人搭档。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver, I will find that person.
dialogue.zh: 韦弗女士，我会找到那个人。

dialogue.speaker: Mimi
dialogue.en: Excuse me. Are you using this chair?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下。这椅子有人用吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, hi! Thanks for meeting me.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，嗨！谢谢你来见我。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Sure. But I don’t have lots of time, Anna. I’m busy looking for work.
dialogue.zh: 好。但我时间不多，安娜。我正忙着找工作。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, you can tear these want ads up and throw them away! I have good news!
dialogue.zh: 皮特，这些招聘广告你可以撕掉扔掉！我有好消息！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, I was working on that crossword puzzle.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我正在做那份填字游戏。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Sorry. Sorry. Pete, forget about the crossword puzzle. I have a job offer for you!
dialogue.zh: 哦。抱歉抱歉。皮特，别想填字游戏了。我有一份工作要给你！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I'm listening.
dialogue.zh: 我听着呢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My boss wants me to team up with someone to host a talk show. But the person must be different from me. So, I thought of you.
dialogue.zh: 老板要我和一个人搭档主持谈话节目。但那个人必须和我不一样。所以我想到了你。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Different from you? What do you mean?
dialogue.zh: 和你不一样？什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm sorry, Pete, I don't have time right now. Here's my boss's address. Your interview is tomorrow morning at 10 am.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，皮特，我现在没时间。这是我老板的地址。你明天上午 10 点面试。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: But what do you mean “different”?
dialogue.zh: 可“不一样”是什么意思？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Just be yourself, Pete. Just be yourself.
dialogue.zh: 做你自己就好，皮特。做你自己。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you find any two-word verbs? Here’s one example. Pete can throw the want ads away! Throw away is a two-word verb.
dialogue.zh: 你找到两个词的动词了吗？举个例子。皮特可以把招聘广告扔掉！throw away 就是短语动词。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Thanks for coming in, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你来，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Thanks for the opportunity, Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢这个机会，韦弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I need to find out if you have the skills for this job. And I want you to be completely honest.
dialogue.zh: 我需要弄清你是否具备这份工作的能力。而且我要你完全诚实。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: First, let's talk about your personal skills. Pete, are you a people person?
dialogue.zh: 先谈谈你的个人能力。皮特，你善于和人相处吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, okay, sometimes I think people talk too much.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，好吧，有时候我觉得人话太多。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Pete, what work of yours are you most proud of?
dialogue.zh: 皮特，你最自豪的作品是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Last year, I locked myself in a cabin and wrote a book. I didn't speak to anybody the entire time! It was the best two months of my life.
dialogue.zh: 去年，我把自己锁在小屋里写了一本书。那段时间我没跟任何人说话！那是我人生中最棒的两个月。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Okay. I think I’ve heard enough.
dialogue.zh: 好。我想我听够了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey! Hey, Pete, how was the interview with Ms. Weaver?
dialogue.zh: 嘿！嘿，皮特，和韦弗女士的面试怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Well, she said I was grumpy and not good with people.
dialogue.zh: 她说我脾气差，不擅长和人相处。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And … ?
dialogue.zh: 然后呢……？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: And, I got the job!
dialogue.zh: 然后，我得到了这份工作！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I knew it! Congratulations! Let's go celebrate.
dialogue.zh: 我就知道！恭喜！我们去庆祝吧。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay!
dialogue.zh: 好！

quiz.prompt: What new assignment does Ms. Weaver give Anna?
Who does Anna ask to interview for the talk show?
What happens after Pete's interview?
choices: Ms. Weaver tells him to try again next year
He throws the want ads away and leaves
He is called grumpy — and he gets the job

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 3
lessons.subtitle: He Said - She Said

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, Pete and I are meeting with a consultant who will help us with our new show. Yesterday, Pete had promised to meet me here at 8:00 am. but he did not come on time.
dialogue.zh: 今天皮特和我要见一位顾问，帮我们做新节目。昨天皮特答应早上 8 点在这儿见我，可他没准时来。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Uh-oh. It’s bad to be late for a business meeting. But while we wait for Pete, let’s talk about a new verb tense -- past perfect! When we talk about two things in the past, we can use the past perfect for the first event. Put "had" before the past participle. "Pete had promised he would meet Anna." Find sentences with the past perfect tense. Remember, look for "had!"
dialogue.zh: 哦哦。商务会议迟到可不好。等皮特的时候，我们来学一个新时态——过去完成时！谈两件过去的事时，先发生的那件用过去完成时。在过去分词前加 had。“Pete had promised he would meet Anna.”请找出过去完成时的句子。记住，找 had！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: You two are late -- exactly 43 minutes late! What happened?
dialogue.zh: 你们俩迟到了——整整晚了 43 分钟！怎么回事？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: He had to get his "special" coffee -- SPECIAL coffee!
dialogue.zh: 他非要去买他的“特制”咖啡——特制咖啡！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: She had to feed her birds -- HER birds!
dialogue.zh: 她非要去喂她的鸟——她的鸟！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Okay, I can see already that you need my help. You can’t both talk at the same time. You have to take turns. Alright, Anna, you go first.
dialogue.zh: 好，我已经看出来你们需要我帮忙。不能同时说话。要轮流。好，安娜，你先说。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure. Kelly, see, Pete and I live in the same building. So, we decided to meet at 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m. to come to work together. I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived!
dialogue.zh: 好。凯利，你看，皮特和我住同一栋楼。所以我们约好早上 8 点——8 点一起去上班。皮特到的时候，我已经等了 15 分钟！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late. I left you a message.
dialogue.zh: 皮特浪费时间等咖啡之后，我们就迟到了。我给你留了言。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Hum. I didn’t get that message.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。我没收到那条留言。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Sorry.
dialogue.zh: 哦。抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Pete?
dialogue.zh: 皮特？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna left a message. That’s the right thing to do. Did you find some examples of the past perfect sentences? I did. Anna said, "After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late." Look at that coffee! It looks more like dessert! Okay, keep watching for past perfect!
dialogue.zh: 安娜留了言。这样做是对的。你找到过去完成时的例子了吗？我找到了。安娜说：“After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late.”看看那杯咖啡！看起来更像甜点！好，继续找过去完成时！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, that’s not why we’re late. This is why we’re late: I had arrived on time at 8:00 a.m. but didn’t see Anna. She was standing behind a tree. I think she was hugging it. I always walk to work. But she said that would take too long and that a scooter would be much faster. It was awful. I hated it. And it added too much time to our commute!
dialogue.zh: 对，我们迟到不是因为那个。原因是这样：我早上 8 点准时到了，可没看见安娜。她站在一棵树后面。我觉得她在抱树。我一向走路上班。可她说那样太慢，滑板车会快得多。太糟了。我讨厌它。还让通勤更久！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Then Anna stopped by a pond to feed the birds. She had named them after characters from books and yelled the names out loud … Romeo! Juliet! Sherlock! By the time she had fed all the birds, we were late.
dialogue.zh: 然后安娜在池塘边停下来喂鸟。她用书里的人物给鸟起了名字，还大声喊……罗密欧！朱丽叶！福尔摩斯！等她喂完所有的鸟，我们已经晚了。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: This is what I think. You two see the same event very differently. Does this happen often with you two?
dialogue.zh: 我是这么想的。你们对同一件事看法很不一样。你们俩经常这样吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是。

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: Okay. This is good. This is good! It’s good to see things differently. I have an idea: we will call the show "He Said, She Said." For every story, you tell a different point of view.
dialogue.zh: 好。这很好。这很好！看法不同是好事。我有个主意：节目就叫《他说，她说》。每个故事，你们讲不同的角度。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is a great idea, Kelly! Pete, we are different. That’s why I thought of you for this job!
dialogue.zh: 好主意，凯利！皮特，我们不一样。所以我才想到让你做这份工作！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: I think you two understand perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 我觉得你们俩完全明白了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let’s get to work!
dialogue.zh: 开始干活吧！

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.en: She named the birds? Really?
dialogue.zh: 她给鸟起名字？真的？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah…

quiz.prompt: How late are Anna and Pete for the meeting?
What does Pete say made them late?
choices: Anna hugged a tree, took a scooter, and fed the birds
They could not find the studio

quiz.prompt: What will Anna and Pete's show be called?

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 4
lessons.subtitle: Run Away With the Circus!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, I’m Anna …
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是安娜……

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: … and I’m Pete. Welcome to “He Said,
dialogue.zh: ……我是皮特。欢迎来到《他说，

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: … She Said”!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Because there are always two sides …
dialogue.zh: 因为任何事总有两面……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: to every story!
dialogue.zh: 每个故事都是！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today’s show is about Circus Arts!
dialogue.zh: 今天的节目是关于马戏艺术！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Circus? That’s not an art form.
dialogue.zh: 马戏？那不是一种艺术。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it is.
dialogue.zh: 是的，它是。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, it isn't.
dialogue.zh: 不，不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it is.
dialogue.zh: 是的，它是。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, it isn't.
dialogue.zh: 不，不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it is!
dialogue.zh: 是的，它是！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, it isn't.
dialogue.zh: 不，不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it is!
dialogue.zh: 是的，它是！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No, it isn't.
dialogue.zh: 不，不是。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, it is!
dialogue.zh: 是的，它是！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh dear. Anna and Pete do not agree about Circus Arts. But that's okay. Today’s lesson is about agreeing and disagreeing. Let’s listen to how Anna and Pete disagree or agree. Let’s hope these two can agree on something.
dialogue.zh: 天哪。安娜和皮特对马戏艺术意见不一。不过没关系。今天的课是关于同意和不同意。我们听听他们怎么反对或同意。希望他俩能在某件事上达成一致。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, let’s run away with the circus! Recently, I went to a circus festival. There was a huge circus tent. And many different circus performers. It was a celebration of circus arts!
dialogue.zh: 今天，我们跟着马戏团跑吧！最近我去了一个马戏节。有一座巨大的马戏帐篷，还有很多不同的马戏演员。那是一场马戏艺术的庆典！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: That looks fun, Anna. But I don’t think circus performers are artists. I think they’re athletes with interesting skills … and costumes.
dialogue.zh: 看起来很好玩，安娜。但我不认为马戏演员是艺术家。我觉得他们是有有趣技能的运动员……还有服装。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hmm, that is a very interesting point of view, Pete. And I completely disagree.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，这观点很有意思，皮特。而我完全不同意。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna, Michelangelo was an artist. Rembrandt was an artist. People who swing from ropes are not artists. I know it’s not easy to swing from a bar and catch someone by the hands. You have to be very athletic to do that.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，米开朗琪罗是艺术家。伦勃朗是艺术家。在绳子上荡的人不是艺术家。我知道从杠上荡过去再用手接住一个人不容易。那得非常有运动能力。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s a good point, Pete. They are athletic. But they are called trapeze artists. Trapeze … ARTISTS.
dialogue.zh: 说得好，皮特。他们确实很有运动能力。但他们叫高空秋千艺术家。高空秋千……艺术家。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I hear what you’re saying, Anna. I do. But where is the art? Look at these guys. They’re jugglers.
dialogue.zh: 我听懂你的意思，安娜。真的。可艺术在哪儿？看看这些人。他们是杂耍的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, they are skilled in the art of juggling.
dialogue.zh: 对，他们精通杂耍这门艺术。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: They have a special skill. But are they artists?
dialogue.zh: 他们有特殊技能。但他们是艺术家吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes!
dialogue.zh: 是！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: No! They're just throwing things back and forth.
dialogue.zh: 不是！他们只是把东西扔来扔去。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Kind of like you and me, Pete. We’re going back and forth on this issue.
dialogue.zh: 有点像你和我，皮特。我们在这个问题上也来回争。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I don’t think we’ll ever agree on this one.
dialogue.zh: 我觉得这件事我们永远不会同意。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, but we can agree that these young people are amazing.
dialogue.zh: 不会完全同意，但我们可以同意这些年轻人很了不起。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay, yeah. We can agree on that. But, still, they are very athletic – flipping and throwing each other around.
dialogue.zh: 好，对。这点可以同意。不过他们还是很有运动能力——翻腾，还把彼此抛来抛去。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I agree with you on that point.
dialogue.zh: 对，在这点上我同意你。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: They did it! They agreed!! Anna says she agrees that the performers are athletic. "That’s a good point, Pete. They are athletic. I agree with you on that point." Now look for other ways they agree.
dialogue.zh: 他们做到了！他们同意了！！安娜说她同意演员们很有运动能力。“说得好，皮特。他们很有运动能力。在这点上我同意你。”再找找他们同意的其他说法。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Anna? Anna!!
dialogue.zh: 安娜？安娜！！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry! Sorry! But he’s an artist too. He is telling a story with his sticks and his costume.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！抱歉！可他也是艺术家。他在用棍子和服装讲故事。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: What story? What costume?
dialogue.zh: 什么故事？什么服装？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I see your point, Pete. I really do. But circus performers do more than physical tricks. Look! Look at these amazing performers!
dialogue.zh: 我明白你的意思，皮特。真的明白。可马戏演员做的不只是体能技巧。看！看这些了不起的演员！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: I will admit -- I like their costumes.
dialogue.zh: 我承认——我喜欢他们的服装。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, Pete. Let’s let the performers speak for themselves.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，让演员们自己来说吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Kate and Piper tell stories while hanging upside down on a ring!
dialogue.zh: 凯特和派珀倒挂在圆环上讲故事！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Was it hard to interview them upside down?
dialogue.zh: 倒过来采访他们很难吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I interviewed them right side up, Pete. Kate says circus performing may be athletic but it’s not competitive. With most sports, you compete.
dialogue.zh: 我是正着采访的，皮特。凯特说马戏表演也许很有运动性，但不是竞技。大多数运动都是比赛。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: It’s an art form because like, other sports are competing. This is simply performing and having fun.
dialogue.zh: 它是一种艺术，因为别的运动是在竞赛。这只是表演，并且玩得开心。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Okay, Kate made a really good point. In athletics, there is a lot of competition. But still …
dialogue.zh: 好，凯特说得很有道理。体育运动里有很多竞争。不过还是……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Here’s Piper, Pete. Please pay attention, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 这是派珀，皮特。请注意听，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: But, I -
dialogue.zh: 可是，我——

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Shh.
dialogue.zh: 嘘。

dialogue.speaker: Piper
dialogue.en: Well, when you’re up in the air doing circus you have to perform. And so, we learn to embody characters, and to move fluidly and gracefully … in artistic ways.
dialogue.zh: 在空中做马戏时，你必须表演。所以我们学习去扮演角色，流畅而优雅地移动……用艺术的方式。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And that …is why they are artists!
dialogue.zh: 而这……就是他们是艺术家的原因！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: You’re right, Anna. Oh, you’re right. It’s just so beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 你说得对，安娜。哦，你是对的。真的太美了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know. I know, Pete.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。我知道，皮特。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Good job you two! I'm so glad that Anna and Pete finally agree! Pete said, "You’re right, Anna." I agree, too. Circus arts are beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 干得好！真高兴安娜和皮特终于同意了！皮特说：“你说得对，安娜。”我也同意。马戏艺术很美。

quiz.prompt: What is today's "He Said, She Said" show about?
What do Anna and Pete first disagree about?
Why does Kate say circus is an art form?
choices: It has more competition than sports
It is simply performing and having fun

lessons.title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 5
lessons.subtitle: Greatest Vacation of All Time

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: “Do you need a vacation?” Wow. That was the best vacation I have ever had … in my head. A beach is much better than here. I need a vacation!
dialogue.zh: “你需要度假吗？”哇。那是我有过最好的假期……在脑子里。海滩比这儿好多了。我需要度假！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I hear you, Anna. I need a vacation too but not at the beach. Sand is not good for robots! When we compare things, we use special forms of adjectives. "Better" is a comparative adjective. "Best" is a superlative adjective. It shows that one thing has more of ...something than ALL of the others. Try to find more of these adjectives. Look for ER or EST at the end.
dialogue.zh: 我懂你，安娜。我也需要度假，但不要去海滩。沙子对机器人不好！比较事物时，形容词要用特殊形式。better 是比较级。best 是最高级，表示某样东西比其他所有都更……找找更多这样的形容词。注意词尾的 ER 或 EST。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: NO! You can’t get your money back. I don’t care that it was your worst vacation ever!
dialogue.zh: 不行！不能退钱。我不管那是你最糟糕的假期！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Hello! Have a seat! Welcome to the World’s Best Vacation Travel Agency!
dialogue.zh: 你好！请坐！欢迎来到世界最佳度假旅行社！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you and congratulations!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，并祝贺你们！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: For what?
dialogue.zh: 祝贺什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: For being the world’s best travel agency.
dialogue.zh: 因为你们是世界最佳旅行社。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Right … thanks.
dialogue.zh: 对……谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Trudy, hold my calls. I am going to sell our most expensive vacation.
dialogue.zh: 特鲁迪，帮我挡电话。我要卖掉我们最贵的度假。

dialogue.speaker: Trudy
dialogue.en: Sure thing, Boss.
dialogue.zh: 没问题，老板。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: The Mountain Getaway is good for you. It’s a little pricey. But think of it -- you, on top of a mountain for seven days!
dialogue.zh: 山地度假适合你。有点贵。但想想看——你，在山顶上待七天！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m afraid of high places.
dialogue.zh: 我恐高。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Of course you are. That’s why our Deep Sea Adventure is better for you! It is pricier than the Mountain Getaway. Just you and the animals of the sea!
dialogue.zh: 当然你会恐高。所以我们的深海探险更适合你！它比山地度假更贵。只有你和海里的动物！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Shark! Shark!
dialogue.zh: 鲨鱼！鲨鱼！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: No, there are no sharks in your dream vacation! You need the Safari Camp Out! It is our priciest vacation. But I think it’s the best one for you. During the day, you’ll see elephants, giraffes and lions. At night, you’ll sleep out under the stars.
dialogue.zh: 不，你的梦幻假期里没有鲨鱼！你需要野生动物园露营！这是我们最贵的度假。但我觉得最适合你。白天看大象、长颈鹿和狮子。晚上在星空下睡觉。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look, I think this was a bad idea.
dialogue.zh: 听着，我觉得这是个坏主意。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Sure, you can leave. But then you won’t see the latest vacation technology.
dialogue.zh: 当然，你可以走。但那就看不到最新的度假科技了。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you find all of those adjectives? Dan started with good - The mountain getaway; then he moved to better - The Deep Sea Adventure. And finally, he said the Safari Campout was the best vacation for Anna!
dialogue.zh: 这些形容词都找到了吗？丹从 good 开始——山地度假；然后到 better——深海探险。最后他说野生动物园露营是最适合安娜的假期！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Exactly what is the “latest vacation technology” … exactly?
dialogue.zh: 这个“最新度假科技”到底……到底是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: I’m happy you asked. Meet the Travel Max 2000!
dialogue.zh: 很高兴你问了。来见见 Travel Max 2000！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow.
dialogue.zh: 哇。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: So, tell me, how do you like to travel?
dialogue.zh: 那么告诉我，你喜欢怎么旅行？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I like travel that is cozy and romantic but still exciting.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢舒适又浪漫、但仍然刺激的旅行。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Great. Tell me more.
dialogue.zh: 很好。再说说。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I like traveling in a plane but not in a helicopter! Planes are a little scary but helicopters are scarier! My favorite way of traveling is by train. Ships can be the scariest! Have you seen the movie “Titanic”? Oh, and no horses. But I will ride a camel. And no bike tours. Biking is THE slowest AND least romantic way to travel. Excuse me, but I think the Travel Max 2000 is on fire.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢坐飞机，但不坐直升机！飞机有点可怕，直升机更可怕！我最喜欢坐火车。船可能最可怕！你看过电影《泰坦尼克号》吗？哦，不要骑马。但骆驼我可以骑。也不要骑行之旅。骑车是最慢、最不浪漫的旅行方式。不好意思，我觉得 Travel Max 2000 着火了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Yes, we’re both on fire! We really want to sell you the most ex-, I mean, best vacation ever!
dialogue.zh: 对，我们都燃起来了！我们真的很想卖给你最贵——我是说，有史以来最好的假期！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I mean it’s really on fire!
dialogue.zh: 不，我是说它真的着火了！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: You killed it. You killed the Travel Max 2000!
dialogue.zh: 你弄坏了它。你弄坏了 Travel Max 2000！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am so sorry! Can I help you fix it?
dialogue.zh: 非常抱歉！我能帮你修吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: No, no!
dialogue.zh: 不，不！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don’t cry. I know what you need -- a vacation!
dialogue.zh: 别哭。我知道你需要什么——度假！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The Safari Campout looks fun. It is the priciest. But I think you deserve it.
dialogue.zh: 野生动物园露营看起来很好玩。它最贵。但我觉得你值得。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: No, no!
dialogue.zh: 不，不！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Oh Anna. This is the smokiest lesson yet! There were a lot of comparatives and superlatives but … I can’t breathe.
dialogue.zh: 哦安娜。这是目前烟最大的一课！比较级和最高级很多，可是……我喘不过气了。

quiz.prompt: Where does Anna walk into?
choices: The World's Best Vacation Travel Agency

quiz.prompt: Why does Anna reject the Mountain Getaway?
choices: She is afraid of high places
She wants to ride a bike

quiz.prompt: What happens to the Travel Max 2000?
